Hi there, it’s Nancy Lacore, the Democrat running to flip South Carolina’s First District.
I have a lot of thoughts about what’s been going on with Pete Hegseth.
Not only did he remove me from my position as Chief of the Navy Reserve after 35 years of service, but he’s actively undermining the foundation of our military.
Hegseth has fired more than a dozen senior military officers, including an Army chief of staff and two other generals who were ousted recently.

body:
Meet the speakers of Freedom Fest, only 12 days away!
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**June 14, 2026** **SUNDAY NEWS DIGEST**
| | Dear Rocky Mountain Voice family,
Happy Flag Day! 🇺🇸
On June 14, 1777, the Continental Congress adopted the Stars and Stripes as the official flag of the United States. Nearly 250 years later, that flag still flies over a nation that is far from perfect—but remains the greatest experiment in self-government the world has ever known.
And that's exactly why Freedom Fest matters.
In just **12 days** , Coloradans from across the state will gather to celebrate America's 250th Birthday and Colorado's 150th Birthday—not simply to talk about freedom, but to celebrate it.
And this week, we want to introduce a few of the voices joining us.
🎤 **[Seth Keshel](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** is a former Army intelligence captain and election analyst whose work has earned the attention of leaders like Newt Gingrich. Whether you agree with his conclusions or not, Keshel has become one of the most influential voices in the election integrity movement and will be speaking Friday at Freedom Fest.
🎤 **[Pastor Lorenzo Sewell](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** brings one of the most powerful redemption stories we've ever featured. From drug dealer to pastor, his journey from Detroit's streets to delivering the benediction at President Trump's inauguration is a testament to faith, second chances, and the power of transformation. He'll speak on the main stage and at the Mountain Majesty Gala.
🎤 **[Mark Cook](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** has spent years studying election systems and advocating for greater transparency and local oversight. A former technology professional, Cook argues that restoring trust in elections starts with putting more power back in the hands of voters and county clerks.
🎤 **[Larry Gatlin](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** may be best known for his legendary music career, but our recent interview revealed something deeper: a grandfather, storyteller, man of faith, and defender of the values he believes are worth passing on to the next generation.
🎤 **[Erin Lee](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** will also take the stage after becoming one of Colorado's most prominent parental rights advocates. Her story—and the broader debate over student speech and parental involvement in schools—has resonated with families across the state.
**🎤[Patti Fox](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** will share the heartbreaking story of her daughter Carissa, whose life was forever changed after a devastating crash. Her story has become a powerful reminder of perseverance, faith, and the human cost behind public policy debates.
🎤 **[Jacki& Noelle Caskey](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** became national voices for student speech after 13-year-old Noelle was barred from reading her pro-life poem in class because it was deemed "too politically charged." What started as a school assignment reached millions online, and the mother-daughter duo will share their story of standing up for free expression, parental rights, and the courage to speak your beliefs.
_**🎟️ A Few Important Freedom Fest Updates**_
**Kids Attend Free:** We've made it even easier for families to join us. _Children 17 and under now receive**free Bronze Pass** admission with a ticketed adult. That includes access to the rodeo, Family Fun Festival, Curtis Grimes concert, candidate meet-and-greet, food vendors, and more._
**Pricing Changes:** We made pricing more accessible and easy to understand! 🥉 _**Bronze Pass $45**_ \- _rodeo, Family Fun Festival, Curtis Grimes concert, candidate meet-and-greet, food vendors, and more._ 🥈 _**Silver Pass $95** \- everything in Bronze + all speakers Friday & Saturday (includes Gutfeld!) + Back the Blue Bash._ 🥇 _**Gold Pass $195** \- everything in Silver + Mountain Majesty Gala + drone show!_ 💎 _**Platinum VIP $495** \- everything in Gold + VIP seating, parking & PHOTO with Nick Shirley!_
**Volunteers Needed:** Want to be part of the team helping make Freedom Fest happen? We're actively recruiting volunteers and would love your help. Whether it's guest services, logistics, setup, or hospitality, there are opportunities for everyone. _**[Click here to sign up!](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**_
👉 **[Get your tickets now!](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
In truth & liberty,
Team RMV
---
[FREEDOM FEST TICKETS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
| | |
---
| | **TOP STORIES OF THE WEEK**
---
**[Colorado grew on a wave. The wave is gone.](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY SHAINA COLE, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) Colorado crossed six million people in 2025, according to the U.S. Census Bureau. Headlines called it a milestone. What they didn’t report is how the state got there, and what’s left now that the wave behind the growth has receded.

**[Colorado calls its elections a model. Mark Cook says voters have lost oversight of them](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY RMV STAFF, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) Colorado’s top election officials call the state’s voting system a national model. Secretary of State Jena Griswold has described it as the “gold standard,” pointing to first-in-the-nation risk-limiting audits, bipartisan checks and ballot tracking.

**[Eleven Colorado lawmakers on the ballot first reached office through appointment](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY JEN SCHUMANN, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) Every Coloradan who feels ignored at the Capitol can take comfort in this: they have not one but two people assigned to listen. Your House member splits attention among roughly 92,500 residents. Your senator, among about 171,800.

|
---
**STATE**
**[From coal transition to data centers: JOLT summit heads to Grand Junction](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY JEN SCHUMANN, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) Before JOLT became an annual summit, local leaders across Northwest Colorado were wrestling with a difficult question: What comes after coal? Now they’re holding their fourth summit, and this year’s program includes discussions on geothermal energy, data centers, critical minerals, electric cooperative power supplies, workforce development and Colorado River issues.
**[From dope dealer to hope dealer: Detroit pastor Lorenzo Sewell brings message of redemption to Colorado](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY SHAINA COLE, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) He walked into church on April 18, 1999, with a bruised brow, money in his pocket, and murder on his mind. By the time he walked out, Lorenzo Sewell had given his life to Christ. That same day he went to his drug boss and quit. That day, and that decision, is the foundation of everything Sewell has built since.
**[Property taxes up, TABOR refunds nearly gone: El Paso County data reveals the real cost of Colorado’s tax system](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY SHAINA COLE, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) The first-half property tax payment is due every year by the end of February. The number on the front has gone up again. Somewhere near the bottom, a small credit appears: “TABOR credit.”
_**[READ MORE STATE NEWS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**_
|
---
**LOCAL**
**[Colorado Mountain Town Revolts After AI Cameras and Robots Spark Privacy Concerns](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**[THE COLORADO SUN](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) First, it was the robots. They were trundling along sidewalks in Paonia last summer gathering data on how accommodating those thoroughfares were for people with disabilities. The wandering robots took townspeople by complete surprise.
**[Denver Public Schools Grows Bureaucracy While Student Population Declines](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**[DENVER GAZETTE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) Denver Public Schools (DPS) has operated with thousands fewer students than its peak enrollment in 2019 but it has grown its administrative ranks back to nearly their pre-pandemic level, a Denver Gazette analysis of state staffing data shows.
__
**[Cherry Creek Schools Target Of New Federal Civil Rights Investigation](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [DENVER GAZETTE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) The U.S. Department of Education opened an investigation into Cherry Creek School District on Monday over allegations of racial discrimination. The department said its Office for Civil Rights is reviewing claims that the district violated Title VI of the Civil Rights Act by sponsoring “a wide range of racially-discriminatory programming.”
**_[READ MORE LOCAL NEWS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)_**
|
---
**COMMENTARY**
**[Five candidates agreed Colorado has problems. Voters must decide who owns them](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY RMV EDITORIAL BOARD, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) _Colorado has become so expensive that starter homes are starting to sound less like milestones and more like bucket-list items. Businesses are beginning to treat Colorado the way some retirees treat winter: nice place to visit, not entirely sure about staying. The surprising part isn’t that Republicans said so. It’s that Democrats did too._ __
**[The reliability weapon: Humpty’s wall](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY DRAKE HUNTER, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) _Most people think the lesson of Humpty Dumpty is about falling. It isn’t. It’s about trust. You don’t sit on a wall unless you trust the wall. You don’t climb high unless you trust what holds you up. And you don’t build relationships unless you trust the people around you. The real tragedy wasn’t that Humpty fell. Everyone falls._
**[If Polis vetoed it, maybe Colorado should take a closer look](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**[COLORADO ACCOUNTABILITY PROJECT](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) _I guess we can’t say Polis never vetoes, it’s just rare. I wanted to share a couple of articles (one by Complete Colorado linked first below and the second by CPR) detailing some vetoes from Governor Polis this legislative session. I’ll leave it to you to poke around in either or both articles, but there are a couple of notable things I wanted to mention._
**_[READ MORE COMMENTARY](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)_**
|
---
**NATIONAL**
**[Rand Paul Releases Records Alleging Years of NIH Biosafety Failures](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**[JUST THE NEWS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) New documents released by Senate Committee on Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs Chairman Rand Paul, R-Ky., reveal that two National Institutes of Health scientists were charged with conspiring to smuggle monkeypox virus samples into the United States after returning from the Congo.

**[Senate Approves $70 Billion Immigration Enforcement Funding Package](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**[NPR NEWS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) The U.S. Senate passed an approximately $70 billion funding bill for federal immigration enforcement, without any reforms, early Friday morning, 52-47. Colorado Sen. John Hickenlooper voted against the measure, while Sen. Michael Bennet missed the final passage vote and the preceding 18-hour marathon of back-to-back amendment votes known as a “vote-a-rama.” __
**[Christians cannot retreat from the public square](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [UNDERCURRENT SUBSTACK](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) _Many American Christians have mistaken political exhaustion for spiritual wisdom. They look at the public square and see corruption, division, ambition, deceit, and the machinery of worldly power. Then, with a kind of pious resignation, they conclude that politics is simply too dirty for the faithful._
_**[READ MORE NATIONAL NEWS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**_
|

We vote for candidates. We also vote for principles. No issue is more of a core principle on your ballot than our fundamental right to vote. With Trump's MAGA movement working to suppress the vote and using government agencies to raid voter registration groups, the importance of this election is clear.
Please, Team, RUSH $35 or more right now to fuel our work to register, inform, and turn out every voter possible for the midterms >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=061426_3&amount=35]
Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
Our democracy is on your ballot this year, Team , seriously.
This isn’t just a figure of speech or hyperbole. More than a third of state ballot measures that voters like you will face this year relate to our democracy. On top of that, voters nationwide are electing the officials who will run the 2028 elections with their votes in the midterms.
That’s why our work to inform, register, and turn out voters is more important than ever. Pitch in $35 or whatever you can to help fuel our work for voting rights today >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=061426_3&amount=35]

By Election Day, voters will make decisions on voting rights, election processes, redistricting, and many other key electoral issues, let alone control of Congress, state legislatures, governorships, and more.
We have our chance to directly fight back against the voter suppression and voter discrimination we're seeing play out in real time from the anti-voting elected officials in power right now.
But opponents of voting rights are still hard at work to disenfranchise voters who have a say in these decisions, because they know that our vote is our power . That's why we’re so focused on voter registration, education, and empowerment. Our fundamental right to vote is at stake, and we cannot afford to lose.

Integrity First Voter Action Project is dedicated to expanding ballot access and increasing voter participation across the country.
Since the Supreme Court gutted key provisions in the Voting Rights Act, extreme politicians have taken advantage to pass harsh laws that restrict access to the ballot box. These restrictions particularly affect disadvantaged communities and people of color. It’s our goal to bring awareness to these laws wherever they may crop up and organize voters to take action to ensure the right to vote is available to everyone in their states and communities.

body:

Derek, The latest public poll of the general election in Ohio was just released, and you need to take a look: [](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-brown-split?refcode=em_20260614_7550_fr&amount=20&refcode2=7550_22930333_mE4nEG&akid=7550%2E22930333%2EmE4nEG) This is a big deal. The data proves Ohio is ready to unseat my opponent, Jon Husted, and pave a path for us to flip the Senate in November. **The momentum behind our campaign is growing, but so is the target on our backs. Republicans can see we’re putting up a fight, and they’re going to do whatever it takes to try and stop us in our tracks.** [**Before I say more, can you split any amount between my campaign and the DNC so we can hit our $100K rapid response goal and take on whatever’s next?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-brown-split?amount=20&refcode=em_20260614_7550_fr&refcode2=7550_22930333_mE4nEG&akid=7550%2E22930333%2EmE4nEG) **[SPLIT $20](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-brown-split?amount=20&refcode=em_20260614_7550_fr&refcode2=7550_22930333_mE4nEG&akid=7550%2E22930333%2EmE4nEG)** What we’re building together is truly remarkable, and I see it at every stop I make across the state. body:
https://hanksforcolorado.com?utm_source=Hanks+for+Colorado&utm_campaign=2501ac22e9-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2026_06_15_02_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-2501ac22e9-586962644

Conservative Republican · US House – District 3 · June 30 Primary

🏴 Happy Flag Day — 16 Days Until June 30 — Your Ballot Is In Your Hands 🏴
▶ Watch Ron's Flag Day Message → (https://youtube.com/shorts/UXVPNJpukeA?feature=share&utm_source=Hanks+for+Colorado&utm_campaign=2501ac22e9-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2026_06_15_02_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-2501ac22e9-586962644)

An Appeal to Patriots and Veteran Voters on Flag Day

It has been an emotional stretch of patriotic holidays — Memorial Day, D-Day, Flag Day, with Independence Day approaching in our nation's 250th year. I'm grateful President Trump is leading, but I see real threats on the horizon and at home.

I served 32 years in the Air Force — active, reserve, civilian, enlisted, and commissioned. More than half my life in uniform. I'm fully vested in this country, yet uneasy about where we stand. Our government has grown too powerful, operated covertly against its own citizens, wasted our treasure, and laundered it for their political benefit. It belonged to our families and children.

This government no longer represents us. Career politicians treat their districts as inconveniences while lobbyists and DC insiders pull the strings. They mail deceptive LIAR FLYERS by the ton, dodge town halls and interviews, and protect the status quo.

I'm running for Congress for one final tour of duty: Advance the America First agenda, help elect the next conservative President, then come home after four years — citizen-soldier, citizen-legislator, citizen again. That's the model our Founders established and challenged us to keep.

I've done the interviews with local papers, radio, and TV. My opponent has declined them. I've answered dozens of detailed questionnaires with clear positions. He offers generics. I've sought zero endorsements — just your consideration and your vote.
------------------------------------------------------------
Ron Showed Up. Hurd Didn't.

** Two major CD3 newspapers asked both candidates the hard questions this week.
------------------------------------------------------------

Ron answered every one. Jeff Hurd declined to be interviewed.

Grand Junction Sentinel

** Q&A: Ron Hanks — Challenging Rep. Jeff Hurd from the Right in CD3
------------------------------------------------------------

Ron answered every hard question on tariffs, federal lands, the border, and constituent access. Jeff Hurd? No comment.
READ THE FULL Q&A → (https://www.gjsentinel.com/news/western_colorado/q-a-ron-hanks-challenging-rep-jeff-hurd-from-the-right-in-cd3/article_635eb49f-2fdd-46c2-bb58-6f0596f64c0a.html?utm_source=Hanks+for+Colorado&utm_campaign=2501ac22e9-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2026_06_15_02_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-2501ac22e9-586962644)

Aspen Times

** A Republican Congressman Is Trying to Hold Onto His Western Colorado Seat. His Primary Challenger Says the District Needs a Stronger Conservative.
------------------------------------------------------------

The Aspen Times covered the CD3 primary — and noted Hurd declined to participate.
READ THE FULL ARTICLE → (https://www.aspentimes.com/news/colorado-rep-jeff-hurd-congressman-conservative/?utm_source=Hanks+for+Colorado&utm_campaign=2501ac22e9-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2026_06_15_02_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-2501ac22e9-586962644)
▶ WATCH: Ron Hanks on Free State Colorado — Full Interview (https://youtu.be/9K4CO4hqsVw?si=Xc48h5P_V2cAIiyO&utm_source=Hanks+for+Colorado&utm_campaign=2501ac22e9-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2026_06_15_02_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-2501ac22e9-586962644)
------------------------------------------------------------

** 🌟 Ron On the Issues — Real Questions. Straight Answers.
------------------------------------------------------------

Every video in this series is a real question — answered directly. No handlers. No script. No dodge. 32 years of service means you've earned the straight answer every time.
WATCH RON ON THE ISSUES → (https://hanksforcolorado.com/q-a?utm_source=Hanks+for+Colorado&utm_campaign=2501ac22e9-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2026_06_15_02_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-2501ac22e9-586962644)
------------------------------------------------------------

Visit HanksForColorado.com (https://hanksforcolorado.com?utm_source=Hanks+for+Colorado&utm_campaign=2501ac22e9-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2026_06_15_02_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-2501ac22e9-586962644) to learn more.

If you want a true conservative who will support President Trump, vote for me — Top Line on the ballot. My opponent is rated "F" by Heritage Action (https://heritageaction.com/scorecard/members/H001100?utm_source=Hanks+for+Colorado&utm_campaign=2501ac22e9-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2026_06_15_02_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-2501ac22e9-586962644) , a full 26 points below average.

We have the greatest system of government in the world, but corruption and waste have overwhelmed it. Fake conservatives won't fix it. I will.
Respectfully,

Ron Hanks
Candidate, US House of Representatives, District 3

Jun 15
---

| | | [](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=7534176&post_id=202064904&utm_source=substack&isFreemail=true&submitLike=true&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MjAyMDY0OTA0LCJyZWFjdGlvbiI6IuKdpCIsImlhdCI6MTc4MTQ4OTg4MSwiZXhwIjoxNzg0MDgxODgxLCJpc3MiOiJwdWItNzUzNDE3NiIsInN1YiI6InJlYWN0aW9uIn0.EkIg5XBQ9tkLchbVk5gRIhP1GLUde4Oa9Lxh_wE38RM&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=email-reaction&r=1hvr60)

The political class in Nashville has a timeline. They've calculated exactly how much money their corporate PACs will pump into this race, exactly how many lines they need to redraw to secure their "safe seats," and exactly when they expect our grassroots movement to run out of gas.
Right now, they are looking at our end-of-week deadline, waiting to see if we stumble.
**[We are trailing our fundraising goal by $500, and the clock is officially running out.](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/adb0ea28-af62-40f6-9ef4-a544c572132f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

---|---|---
They want to claim that the community has accepted that "normal" is dead. _**Help prove them wrong with a small-dollar donation[HERE.](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/adb0ea28-af62-40f6-9ef4-a544c572132f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**_
[PITCH IN TO OUR GOAL HERE!](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/adb0ea28-af62-40f6-9ef4-a544c572132f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
### **What 's On the Line Right Now**
This isn't about hitting an arbitrary number to look good on a spreadsheet. This goal dictates exactly how hard we can swing back against the corporate machine. Falling short means making compromises we can't afford:
They want us to look at the rigged maps, look at the billion-dollar donor class, and decide it's not worth the fight. They want a quiet, predictable election where career politicians like Scott Desjarlais never have to face a real, well-funded counter-attack.

GOD'S CHILDREN ARE NOT FOR SALE

Friend,

A child who has been trafficked often learns a heartbreaking lesson:

Don't trust anyone.
Not adults.
Not authority figures.

Not even the people trying to help.

That is one of the many reasons I am writing to you today.

My name is Eduardo Verástegui. I am the producer of the film Sound of Freedom and founder of the Sound of Freedom Foundation.

After learning firsthand about the horrors of child trafficking, I dedicated my life to helping protect vulnerable children and supporting efforts to stop this evil.

Over the years, I have met brave men and women who dedicate their lives to rescuing children from trafficking and exploitation.

They walk into places most of us could never imagine.

They investigate crimes no human being should ever have to see.

They sit with children whose innocence has been stolen.

And they carry those memories with them.

Day after day.
Year after year.

That burden is heavy.

https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5MDh9AAwAAAAAAS-Sd4mHWP2bS5_TXIaK6Iw5Oa9YgYxt0T7-zdB78aB4W6k1I65NogAOV4Gqi_tajjhfPWQXC8h47QiwmfWXcB1O6MeQIkmbfrl9izis
Give Now. Bring Comfort.

Sometimes heavier than words can describe.

And that is why I want you to meet someone very special.

Her name is Molly.

https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5MDh9AAwAAAAAAS-Sd4mIseGd6Uu9uE-Nnjxv_J3_RO2s2cpbuzLgYMSdd60zGStnmP01s7DrOACfa9qXZDyYmRtQ-dEVSpeSXCUeS3irqfQ5MdwWATUE

Molly is a Labradoodle.

But to the officers, investigators, and rescued children she serves, she is so much more than a dog.

She is a source of comfort.
A source of peace.
A source of healing.

When an officer has spent hours working a difficult trafficking case, when they’ve witnessed evil no person should ever have to witness and the weight of the day feels almost unbearable...

Molly quietly walks over.

She leans against them.
And she stays.

She does not ask questions.
She does not need explanations.

Her presence alone reminds them they are not carrying this burden by themselves.

Sometimes that simple moment is enough to help someone breathe again.

https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5MDh9AAwAAAAAAS-Sd4mJZZ1dL5look8_vPLcS9j5Skmd9uALmS5cY0kOcu_yrFQvdG2J2jxqt-JSUJOM_QAIzRnvlbsB2EFvyi6jkKXpUX9Y--CG4WuC
Give Now. Bring Comfort.

But Molly's work does not stop there.

Some of the children rescued from trafficking are terrified, confused, and broken.

Many have been manipulated for so long that they do not immediately trust the people trying to help them.

Imagine that. Rescue has arrived. But trauma has taught them to fear everyone.

Then Molly enters the room.

No uniform. No questions. No pressure.

Just gentleness and love.

https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5MDh9AAwAAAAAAS-Sd4mKhOxRb0xj3Jw_8bgFXmOfKZaCaxbH_zSXBPs2dhehUQFHR4SccZVuzAPyMlFe_qPNv99OGkUvdhtWyre2tQv17LvaMwpINA3v

And somehow, walls begin to come down.

Small hands reach out. Tears begin to flow. Fear begins to soften.

And healing can begin.

That healing does not happen by accident.

It happens because one of our trusted anti-trafficking partners walks alongside survivors and the agencies that serve them.

They provide trauma-informed support, resources, and advocacy for lives shattered by trafficking.

Every day, they help children move from fear to freedom, from exploitation to safety, and from hopelessness to renewed hope.

Give Now. Bring Comfort.

I have seen firsthand how powerful these moments can be.

They remind me of the words of Jesus:

"Let the little children come to Me and do not hinder them." (Matthew 19:14)

Every child deserves safety, protection and every child deserves to know they are loved.

And sometimes God uses something as simple as a dog named Molly to help a hurting child take the first step toward healing.

What many people do not realize is that dogs like Molly require up to two years of specialized training.

They are carefully prepared to remain calm in chaotic situations.

They comfort children experiencing trauma and support officers carrying enormous emotional burdens.

They serve in places where hope can feel hard to find.

This training, care, and support are only possible because compassionate people choose to stand with this mission.

Peter,
Right now, rumors are swirling in the nation's capital.
In smoky backrooms across the city, conservative political operatives are whispering among themselves. They see the writing on the wall--the Senate is in serious jeopardy of falling to Democrats this November, perhaps even inevitable.
With only 7 months left of guaranteed control of the chamber necessary to confirm Trump's next picks for the Supreme Court, there's a growing push to force MAGA Justices Samuel Alito (age 76), Clarence Thomas (age 77), and John Roberts (age 71) to retire.
This would hand Trump three more Supreme Court Justice appointments and enshrine MAGA control over the Supreme Court for at least the next 40 years:
---
| [](https://yfq78zhbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001Kj5jjU_vZcp_eClxcQKXXV_vPwwAsp7Tvp_WY_8Fs60xj1Io-OYEflLyqQ4E5GNvqHRWUaX-m28PvJwGnKA0qiPNOtnW3zatpNxWHDB3_cDN9bnPNZR81fZes-ChK2qFdJv962O1ijRpt-7OYZTgAbrum9Vmlu7A_3JU6SjKwiCKJCSp0OFKRkCTzgNHPaN656GbmLpd6iV3gJDKViqTS-756SgqAIX3-6ckkqDApfs=&c=RQAtCCl_XMeEszVW-13xWkQNJj8deHWahgPdeWNqsnXFuUfeSVn3IQ==&ch=ZQMPiHt8-UFWutkjdWW-SK5OeCst-Gq1yY_MId_wYPuIBvShxDgdog==)
---
To accomplish this, MAGA would use the so-called "nuclear option"--a change of Senate rules that allows the appointment of Supreme Court justices via a simple majority vote rather than the 60 vote threshold historically used to confirm justices.
Mitch McConnell used the nuclear option for Trump's appointments of Gorsuch, Kavanaugh, and Coney Barrett. Prior to that, the nuclear option had never been used before in American history for a Supreme Court Justice confirmation. We have seen and felt the consequences of those actions: Roe v. Wade overturned. The Voting Rights Act gutted. Trump handed criminal immunity. The Clean Air and Water Acts gutted.
We cannot endure the hell of another 40 years of a MAGA controlled Supreme Court. We cannot allow Donald Trump, a president who has won both of his elections by historically slim margins, to single-handedly pack this court and dictate the next 4 decades of American history.
That's why we're pushing for Democrats to use a nuclear option of their own--to reform and rebalance the Supreme Court by expanding the amount of justices on the court. This is the only way for Democrats to stop the hell to come. The Constitution gives us that power. Congress has changed the number of justices seven times. No amendment is required.
But for this to become a reality, Democrats need our help. We need to win back control of the House, Senate, and White House by 2028. That's why Defend Our Courts will be fighting for Democrats across the map in hotly contested House and Senate races this November.
This fight is necessary. Unpacking the court is non-negotiable. It must happen, and we need your support to make it a reality: [It's time for Democrats to use the nuclear option and save the country from 40 years of hell. name: Lee McInnis 4 Alabama
subject: Reminder: The latest news for you
body:
You don't want to miss this.
| | | | |
---
# A Letter From Lee
---
Friends,
I wanted to take a few minutes to bring you up to date on the campaign and discuss what we need to do next.
The campaign is exactly where we wanted it to be at this point. We have engaged the local county parties in all eleven counties and are running our campaign operations across the district. We have a group of volunteers, several with congressional staff experience, working on our public outreach, and we're bringing on more volunteers to support that effort. We've also hired professional staff and plan to hire one more person for a key position within the next two weeks.
We're also able to make some social media ad buys, and we will be building that effort over the next few weeks. Finally, next week we will be buying yard signs. We will get you the details on how we will distribute them soon.
As we ramp up operations, here are ways you can help: - Host an Event. Events hosted by supporters have been great for fundraising and have helped us connect with people we would not normally meet. Don't worry, we'll help you with the details. - Organize a Town Hall. This may seem like a lot, but we can help you through it. We just need someone local to help us sort out the details. - Talk to Your Friends. This may be the hardest thing we ask of you, but we'll send you cards to hand out, and that will give you talking points. - Read the Newsletter. The newsletter is how we communicate our campaign schedule, organize volunteers, and keep you up to date on the campaign. - Share Our Social Media Posts. Together, we have tens of thousands of friends on social media. Sharing our posts is the quickest and easiest way to support the campaign.
As always, we also need your financial support. Many of you have already been incredibly generous, but as we head into the final months, hiring campaign staff, buying campaign materials, paying for ads, and renting venues all cost money, and these needs will only increase. Please consider making a financial contribution to keep this campaign running at the same high level we're at now.
We hear it every day. "I was sick of politics, but you really seem like you want to make things better." We're breaking down walls that have stood for decades here in East Alabama. We're changing the conversation, and in November, we're going to change history.
Thank you for supporting our campaign and for all your future contributions.
Be well, and we will talk soon.

---

## Screwworm Cases Rise, CDC Mobilizes
Texas's New World screwworm outbreak continues to grow, with federal officials [confirming 10 cases as of the weekend](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGy2yAURL9G6tAAAskqKNK4c9qUmou4spggcODayPn6N_L7hFdtc-bM7v65zTfwwcf7b9jR0LGmOWItAYkwz3Q8o39liH9Lr2m7h2QhhHeFWXI5MD4woWcHPrxn1TpjuZtEi0aMF6Gl6NXUbmZCNYG2zgKoy3JZOTrUCL1yyg1W2tabU8YHoYXgUupudJMWWgFXatWWq0ZxdJ5S7mhDwgPKGt7phblb0t4GsxE9StP_auS1kddaa7emY4RnIR9PpJHXc9N3sJpycKwsGWtNeWcLFCzso2XZF2SCs5P794QMkXxE9j9FLAwLgQ2-bOjabNyj-hB8GcZG8fsOPnza0M8-fBn5FQAA__-QI4nC) and a quarantine now covering parts of 12 South Texas counties across five designated infested zones. The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) [activated a Level 3 Emergency Operations Center response](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkDGynSAUQFeDHQ4gqK-gSGP306Z07oOrMkFw4Eaeu8_8bCEbOOfM-fW1fkGIIe0_4URLny2vCVuNSIRlpc-fFO4C6XcdDB17zG-I8WmwKqFGLkYuzeohxGfVnbdv4V-yQyunWRolB_3qDmtmZxy8QW7GmGmY3eydwlkMgxzHWU9dsN8wMUojpVDK9JN_GWk0CK038xaaaYE-UC49HUj4gbrFJ99YepfPLtqD6Kps-MHUwtTSWuudd_2eb6aWE30AppaCEaFiZWr5tjG1OO84OAo3EFaOJ5Ydk3t4vrAAhZwqd5gIC99y4Qkbb7lEz6sr2FouJy9Yr5wq9gedsSvWXy3EGOo4MS32E0L8F0j_t_W26m8AAAD__4Q9jmQ) on June 11. While screwworm infestations primarily affect animals including livestock, companion animals, and wildlife, human infestations may occur. Currently, there are no reported human cases in the United States, and the risk to the public remains low. Animal quarantines are now enforced across parts of [10 Texas counties](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0L2uozAQBeCnMZ0j_yahcLEN3d12SzTgCVh3wFf2BIe3X7GvsPUnHZ1z_nyNX5Ao7ctv2DDw55XHHVslZMYy8ue9p6PA_l2t53WhPAHR2WA0ytylukvtxwiJztF1MUwq9rrDoB9P7Y22ru_W0L8mryJMT23BIqJD13vjfW_93D8tdilcYequvdbKGH97xN5r70A59_KTcsIpjIlzufGKjB-oLzrzgeU2562jsDL_VGF_CTMIM7TWbvCOMJ8XCzMw0Le2DyXMcE0TZqA8A11S4EhVzkCxIZFMtb5RxlShMhYZcSYowCnvVUKVdS7YWi6b5LUgsFxKbrUrIf60RJTq_SGcWjZI9K8Z_9-fRzB_AwAA__9H2Yxw), and Travis, Caldwell, Gillespie, Uvalde, and Zavala counties have [issued formal disaster declarations](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkk1vozAYhH8N3Ij8DT5wIB9smoZUadKm2wsy2AFTA5UxkOyvXzXHve71fecZaUZzyfJMaKO76iBaFbvbtc87NQ9GOads7m5jpycruq8BU1dXpi-EMfdZ5AggFgAWQJpLoc09J76MCyA59FUMwwhSBDHhfh2TAhPESUmRJJKFUlEIKeGAC0QkxIWv4x8zwCCFECBEF6HkFFIiACFXWgDiEaCkdr1duFo5dRPD1dz7SdlF2be-iWvnvgcPJx5KPZTO87wQvfn5eSj9CeOhdCitmufetsGDD9rROP1tVFD2Y-e0GgKpSiOsCiBHHDHK-KJ2rfFwWo3lQ6Ssh9fQQ6waS5VbdVXWPm5i-wrKbcb2d44lLsdPxKdPdDP79jAVp-hfIh905eF1ckySJG1fPqLd8dzYbSXIy-8xPLIp3Yro0Czr7DQu5_1hVmqzc6tT9txf1HoonikZ35_We9q-ZegrK7Ly1rw1FQp32K2uW3l--oPPl820fEYNeIebc_k5LLsIXZ0iS3hOIWI6y0n6wnO9-9W5oFsdN6LRxz27XFYRbF9Pb-fhow_3LKLJlj3dR1jhxLex_J61MXpgoUdA1Qr9KNl3_zebKUZ_AwAA__-9ytRl). ## Texas Community's Foreclosures Lead the Nation
Texas is averaging [roughly 4,000 foreclosure filings per month](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0LGOhCAYBOCn0Q4DCKIFxTV2e-2VBuV3JfcLG_hX17e_7L7CdVNMvkzm5zbdXMAQ799uB0uvNU0RzoJABHmi1zOGI7v4W1pN2x3T7BCv002Sy47xjgk9eRfwmlTt7cz9IGqwwvRCS9Gqod6sUb0xbuZc85UPZmmHodW9nsF0Urair4N9Y7wTWggupW6MH7TQynGlVj1zVSkOPlDKDW1A8HJlxSsdkJsl7TXajehRqvarkmMlx_M8m2cMBL6QIygZHMInhnhAeTNL2is5fiS2pH1_1y-G4Hxh0VFIkYXI1pRhwVSeGUolxzpb_zgDYiidqRS_7y7gZwH977fDyr8AAAD__6fphFA) through early 2026, with Harris County emerging as one of the top foreclosure hotspots in the country. The surge isn't a blip--analysts call it persistent financial distress driven by high property taxes, elevated mortgage rates, and a wave of pandemic-era buyers who stretched to buy at peak prices. _"Some of it has to do with rising taxes, property taxes that go into the mortgage payment they make every month. Some of it has to do with buying homes with risky loans,"_ said ABC News' senior manager of data team, [Mark Nichols](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0LHOpCAUBeCnwY4JIOhQUGxj92-7pbnKVckiGLiO49tvZl5h65NzcvL9-Rl_IMSQ1t-wo6P3kseEV41IhGWk95nCq0D6W1tD2xrzBDHeF4xKqI6LjkszegjxHnXj3SS8lQ062T-lUbLVttmcNR0KOc1mAi1aEJ22pu3903d2NhLaJrjPmOikkVIoZR69t0YaDULrxUxCMy3QB8rlQRsSvqEu8c4vLI857010G9FRWfuLqYGpAaZZtp-EqeHIlZgaaj5pQ6jEv20-530_U6CbRwQf0soTUMiJL7ngHHM9C_Lly1J5wSMX4nXLV2VqkFZp9bSSqaEpzh9XiDHUrmdarDuE-P1E_yf5cupfAAAA__9DVYh7). Hello, I hope the summer is going great. My kids are getting out of school for the summer so at least someone's happy.
History was made on Friday with the biggest IPO ever as SpaceX hit the market raising $75 billion. The stock launched at $135 and closed at $160.95 for the day, giving the company a valuation of about $2.1 trillion and making Elon the world's first trillionaire.
"Hey Andrew, you're really smart. What do I do about the SpaceX IPO?"
I got this question from a friend. He had been called by his banker with a message: "I think I can get you an allocation in SpaceX."
A bunch of people got calls like that. There were 21 banks boosting the IPO. That's just about all of them.
They did their job as the stock popped in the first day of trading.
It was a lot of work; the banks moved the IPO to Friday instead of the traditional Thursday to diminish the number of trading hours they would need to support the stock. Turns out that it's tough to find $75 billion in demand for new shares.
To be clear, SpaceX is a tremendous company that will break new ground for years to come. Starlink is a great product, and SpaceX has surpassed every other company or government in launching rockets and satellites into space. But the valuation is . . . high. Analysts peg the objective value of SpaceX's businesses at around $800 billion or so. Again, one of the greatest companies ever created. But well shy of the $2 trillion it's now trading at.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/8c0396ea-7b7c-45d1-bc25-49f640f574ff?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
So what happens next? No one knows. But SpaceX's stock price pits the faith in one man, a compelling story of AI and rockets and connectivity, and the assembled might of America's financial institutions vs. math, gravity and business physics. The banks are about to leave the field, having collected very significant underwriting fees. Many early investors and insiders have just cashed out.
Traditionally, if anyone is left holding the bag, it's the retail investors, many of whom are piling into the stock right now.
We are living in one of the great investment bubbles in human history, this one fueled by AI. One can't time the duration of a bubble. But tread carefully, as gravity tends to win out in the end, even if the business is rockets.
I discuss the SpaceX IPO, James Dolan and some listener questions on the [podcast](https://substack.com/redirect/934da33b-7ac0-4957-bd0c-18ef819ac1bb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) with Zach this week. ## It's Done: Trump Lands the Deal to End the Iran War
Three and a half months of war are coming to a close. President Trump announced Sunday that a framework agreement with Iran is "now complete," calling for the immediate and permanent end of military operations on all fronts. The pact is set to be formally signed Friday in Switzerland — and Trump moved instantly to cash in the dividend, ordering the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz and lifting the U.S. naval blockade.The Terms So Far
* ▸ Combat operations end across the region, including in Lebanon, per mediators from Pakistan and Qatar who brokered the breakthrough.
* ▸ The vital Strait of Hormuz — which carried roughly **20%** of the world's oil before the war — reopens to traffic. "Ships of the World, start your engines. Let the oil flow!" Trump posted.
* ▸ Thornier issues — sanctions relief, frozen Iranian assets, and limits on enrichment — are parked for up to **60 days** of further talks.

The PerspectiveThis is peace through strength, start to finish. The campaign that crippled Iran's military and choked off its oil revenue is precisely what dragged Tehran to terms it spent years refusing. The framework still has to be signed, and Israel is watching the fine print closely — but a war the doubters said would drag on for years is ending on American terms.Read the full story at [CBS News](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/v1/c/3biTctO6hhEkF%2FdYLYXVBn7xhIHqmYbXWsxp2oTzTW4V%2FDRLOKXLCVHEBAq%2F%0AJCRQeW6PP7L7sI2gJBWWqCOxo3TqwW9LrWJHLI5xIMab%2B6mUVJdow1zWorc%2B%0AKKmxFCXxidcbzP5UyOJ1nHGhg6qazTYvFVlMuED%2BwB5WLZT0Jqb4r%2FFBDOWj%0AUy%2FKuFFgrOrFfKOPksa6x%2F7ascEORyTp3Q%3D%3D%0A/82415090b19e255e).
* * *
★ The Economy
## Oil Cracks, Markets Soar — and Relief Is Headed to the Pump
The moment peace looked real, the markets answered. U.S. crude oil tumbled nearly **5%** to about **$81** a barrel — its lowest since early March — while Brent slid to roughly **$84**. Stocks ripped higher across Asia, with Japan's Nikkei surging **5%**.What It Means for You
* ▸ Falling crude flows straight to the gas pump and the grocery aisle — exactly the energy-driven inflation that's been squeezing families since February.
* ▸ The Federal Reserve meets **Wednesday** for Chair Kevin Warsh's debut, and cheaper oil takes the threat of a rate hike off the table that markets feared just last week.
* ▸ Traders are already trimming the odds of any hike this year as the inflation outlook brightens.

The PerspectiveWe told you last week the fastest path to lower prices wasn't another Fed maneuver — it was ending the war. Now the proof is on the screens. End the conflict, and the single biggest driver of the price spikes starts to unwind on its own. That's relief Washington didn't tax, borrow, or print into existence.Read the full story at [CNBC](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/v1/c/cuukShFDtMayTjbtij%2F%2FDLzJzz1gHW4I8NOsK4Rmg9UibdHeOFww51%2BJewRi%0AZesEc%2B53cj2mYazsqIdIm0TJCXIddpnvZHCiKLMP0ZFlN6yjrHeS8FM3Sobp%0AXKVmnRGkiZHNpOjbMfb6jcgqYBXW7RhgR%2FzxCX1lKfmip2YvzWvMxh5lgwPW%0AMa97RkPy9xSKNz1jPAU1mNXpc6wfO1p4%2Fg%3D%3D%0A/045a09141db60727).
* * *
★ The Court
## The Supreme Court's June Blockbusters Could Cement Trump's Agenda
With the term winding down, the justices are sitting on a stack of rulings that could lock in — or unravel — major pieces of the President's second-term agenda. Roughly **two dozen** cases remain unresolved, and several go to the heart of executive power.What's on the Docket
* ▸ **Birthright citizenship:** the marquee case testing Trump's order to end automatic citizenship for the children of those here illegally.
* ▸ **Temporary Protected Status:** cases over the administration's move to wind down TPS shielding more than a million migrants from removal.
* ▸ **Presidential firing power and gun rights** round out a term that could redraw the lines between the branches.

Why It MattersFor years the courts have been the left's favorite tool to freeze conservative policy with nationwide injunctions. A string of rulings affirming executive authority would hand the administration the runway to actually govern — and remind voters that elections, not activist judges, are supposed to set the agenda.Read the full story at [Fox News](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/v1/c/tsJdfNcMIdKhdfgXLCy%2BKoJiRXCJHT0Lvy6Nddmbex1lh1O3k%2Ft%2BnSw8LYde%0ALW67G%2FOXq%2F22cwlTBXnYZGn8fiNH%2FDegK82JXASGdMuUNhx%2Bz38cYRa2o2Fr%0AxcFN%2BHPsaPN4S0a2NiFOfXv8eKnbYuSibL2hqQOk8DdUcDVXqY2o0gyhg6ce%0AThp6ozHCeCWwgA6%2BwTzJRQDS0LQ21yhukg%3D%3D%0A/992be6cf54f471e7).
* * *
★ The World Stage
## Trump Walks Into the G7 Holding the Strongest Hand in the Room
Timing is everything. Just hours after sealing the Iran deal, President Trump landed in France for the G7 summit on the shores of Lake Geneva — turning what could have been a tense sit-down with skeptical allies into a victory lap.The Agenda
* ▸ Host Emmanuel Macron front-loaded the summit with **Iran and Ukraine** , the two issues where Washington and Europe have clashed most.
* ▸ Ukrainian President Zelensky arrives Tuesday to press for more help, while Arab leaders from **Saudi Arabia, the UAE, Qatar, and Egypt** were invited to talk regional security.
* ▸ Trump's deal to end the war reshaped the mood before the first session even began.

The PerspectiveThe same allies who spent months second-guessing the pressure campaign now have to reckon with the result: an American president who said he'd end the war and did. That's leverage — and it travels well.Read the full story at [the Associated Press](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/v1/c/hy58VBddKM3V7oC3dcF0h0JtmBcUSMpaKGagBebAXpNUWMIlz91WXkdagzY%2F%0AB1pPCYVk0YPuW7LvhEsveCA6nSgJSQFWRXUWc7PCi4MOib4%2FAhk45Gw%2Bdu64%0AY8xzfEsEOEQ8dv3%2BFSnjj3Spz%2Fgh2BaECFpO6ZfgVugVUEIvu8l%2BH3EbA89z%0Aa9p33FVXFimdVJJCri20W2PsOQjDkffq%2Fw%3D%3D%0A/02fd5b8242a2ecc0).⚡ The Bottom LineThe war is ending, the oil is set to flow, and the markets are already handing American families the relief that endless Fed tinkering never could. At home, a Supreme Court term that could cement the President's agenda is days from decision, and abroad, Trump walks into the G7 with the one thing his doubters can't argue with — results. President Trump announced Sunday that a framework agreement with Iran is "now complete," calling for the immediate and permanent end of military operations on all fronts. The pact is set to be formally signed Friday in Switzerland — and Trump moved instantly to cash in the dividend, ordering the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz and lifting the U.S. naval blockade.The Terms So Far ▸ Combat operations end across the region, including in Lebanon, per mediators from Pakistan and Qatar who brokered the breakthrough. ▸ The vital Strait of Hormuz — which carried roughly 20% of the world's oil before the war — reopens to traffic. "Ships of the World, start your engines. Let the oil flow!" Trump posted. ▸ Thornier issues — sanctions relief, frozen Iranian assets, and limits on enrichment — are parked for up to 60 days of further talks. The PerspectiveThis is peace through strength, start to finish. The campaign that crippled Iran's military and choked off its oil revenue is precisely what dragged Tehran to terms it spent years refusing. Legendary Live Sound Mixer, Buford Jones has had quite the career. Spanning over 50 years and touring with artists including Pink Floyd, 3 Dog Night, David Bowie and Linda Ronstadt, Mr. Jones has some remarkable stories to tell and fantastic insight for fellow engineers and anyone in the live entertainment industry.
He edited the sound for the very first MTV Unplugged featuring Eric Clapton!
With over 50 years of experience, Buford Jones has transformed live sound for the legendary. His work illustrates a commitment to unparalleled sound quality in live performances.

body:
When fear takes over, Molly brings comfort, trust, and the first steps toward healing.

| [View in Web Browser](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.com/click/e838799/VaHR0cHM6Ly93cm8ubnVjbGV1c2VtYWlsLmNvbS9hbXBsaWZ5L3YvRWNtZ2Y1RkJKMg/SZW1haWxfYW1lcmljYU9ORXN0d2Fycm9vbV9jb20yNjA2MTU/LbmNsM0VYSVpOMA/qP2hpZHM9bmNhb0JTYVdtdHZSOTBscw/gai_8Ww/sdp51ead6b3)
| | | [](https://link.email.america1stwarroom._8Ww/s0l3474005e)
---
| |
---
| | GOD'S CHILDREN ARE NOT FOR SALE
---
|
---
| | | Friend, A child who has been trafficked often learns a heartbreaking lesson: **Don't trust anyone.**
**Not adults.**
**Not authority figures.** Not even the people trying to help. That is one of the many reasons I am writing to you today. My name is Eduardo Verástegui. I am the producer of the film _Sound of Freedom_ and founder of the Sound of Freedom Foundation. After learning firsthand about the horrors of child trafficking, I dedicated my life to helping protect vulnerable children and supporting efforts to stop this evil. Over the years, I have met brave men and women who dedicate their lives to rescuing children from trafficking and exploitation. They walk into places most of us could never imagine. They investigate crimes no human being should ever have to see. They sit with children whose innocence has been stolen. And they carry those memories with them. **Day after day.**
**Year after year.** **That burden is heavy.**
---
[ Give Now. Bring Comfort. ](https://link.email.america1stwarroom._8Ww/s0l3474005e)
---
Sometimes heavier than words can describe. And that is why I want you to meet someone very special. Her name is **Molly.**
---
[](https://link.email.america1stwarroom._8Ww/s0l3474005e)
---
**Molly** is a Labradoodle. But to the officers, investigators, and rescued children she serves, she is so much more than a dog. **She is a source of comfort.**
**A source of peace.**
**A source of healing.** When an officer has spent hours working a difficult trafficking case, when they’ve witnessed evil no person should ever have to witness and the weight of the day feels almost unbearable... **Molly** quietly walks over. She leans against them.
And she stays. **She does not ask questions.**
**She does not need explanations.** **Her presence alone reminds them they are not carrying this burden by themselves.** Sometimes that simple moment is enough to help someone breathe again.
---
[ Give Now. Bring Comfort. ](https://link.email.america1stwarroom._8Ww/s0l3474005e)
---
But **Molly's** work does not stop there. Some of the children rescued from trafficking are terrified, confused, and broken. Many have been manipulated for so long that they do not immediately trust the people trying to help them. Imagine that. Rescue has arrived. But trauma has taught them to fear everyone. **Then Molly enters the room.** No uniform. No questions. No pressure. **Just gentleness and love.**
---
[](https://link.email.america1stwarroom._8Ww/s0l3474005e)
---
And somehow, walls begin to come down. Small hands reach out. Tears begin to flow. Fear begins to soften. **And healing can begin.** **That healing does not happen by accident.** It happens because one of our trusted anti-trafficking partners walks alongside survivors and the agencies that serve them.

They provide trauma-informed support, resources, and advocacy for lives shattered by trafficking.

Every day, they help children move from fear to freedom, from exploitation to safety, and from hopelessness to renewed hope.
---
[ Give Now. Bring Comfort. ](https://link.email.america1stwarroom._8Ww/s0l3474005e)
---
I have seen firsthand how powerful these moments can be. They remind me of the words of Jesus: "Let the little children come to Me and do not hinder them." (Matthew 19:14) Every child deserves safety, protection and **every child deserves to know they are loved.** **And sometimes God uses something as simple as a dog named Molly to help a hurting child take the first step toward healing.** What many people do not realize is that dogs like **Molly** require up to two years of specialized training. They are carefully prepared to remain calm in chaotic situations. They comfort children experiencing trauma and support officers carrying enormous emotional burdens.

body:
| | | | [](https://link.mail.beckwithforcongress.)
---
| | Dear Friend,
Last week, Loudoun County Public Schools Superintendent Aaron Spence sat before the U.S. House Committee on Education and Workforce to answer for what has been happening in our local schools.
The hearing was called "Breaking Trust: Attacks on Parental Rights, Inappropriate Content, and Legal Abuses in America's Schools." That title says it all.
It came on the heels of a number of disturbing reports, similar reports to ones Loudoun parents have been sounding the alarm on for years. They showed up to school board meetings. They spoke out publicly. Some paid a real personal price for it.
**So what has our current congressman, Suhas Subramanyam, done for these families?** **He voted against them.**
When the House passed H.R. 2616, the Stopping Indoctrination and Protecting Kids Act, Suhas was on the wrong side. That bill was simple: schools must get parental consent before changing a child's gender markers, pronouns, or name on school forms, or placing them in opposite-sex locker rooms and bathrooms. It passed 217 to 198. **Suhas voted against it. Loudoun families deserved better.**
Of all the titles I've had in my life - Colonel, Deputy Assistant Secretary, leadership roles in my church and community - homeschool dad is the one I'm most proud of. I believe every parent has the right to choose which belief and values to pass on to their kids, just like I was able to do with my children.
I am running for Congress in Virginia's 10th District because I believe parents, not school administrators and not Washington bureaucrats, are the first and best advocates for their children. What has happened in Loudoun County's schools is not an outlier. It is a warning. When institutions funded by taxpayer dollars stop serving the families they were built to serve, someone has to stand up and say enough.
School is supposed to give every child a strong foundation in reading, writing, and math and prepare them for the road ahead. It is not the place to work out social agendas, conceal information from parents, or tell families that their values are not welcome. Those decisions belong to parents and families alone.

---

The parents of Loudoun County have been fighting this battle largely on their own. It is time they had someone fighting for them in Washington. If you want to help send that someone to Congress, please consider making a donation to our campaign today. Every contribution brings us one step closer to putting a homeschool dad, a 30-year veteran, and a tireless advocate for Loudoun families in Washington.
| | | [DONATE ](https://link.mail.beckwithforcongress.)
---

Friend, I am asking for your support because VA-10 deserves a representative who actually represents its families. If you believe parents should have a seat at the table in their children's education, I hope you will join our campaign.

Warmly, Dave Beckwith

**Beckwith for Congress** _a balanced conservative voice for VA-10_

In its first year and a half, the second Trump administration has proven to be cruel, idiotic, and utterly reckless:
Starting an illegal war in Iran that has put American service members at risk, killed thousands of civilians, including hundreds of children, and predictably raised fuel costs exorbitantly for all.

Attempting to set up a $1.8 billion slush fund to funnel your taxpayer dollars straight to Trump’s cronies, including January 6th insurrectionists.

He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18] | Jacob Davis's Market Brief (ads) | | • | Immersed ---|--- | • | Weiss Ratings Plus ---|--- | • | Immersed ---|--- | | | Market Commentary Disclaimer We encourage all readers to consult a qualified financial professional — such as a registered investment adviser or licensed broker — before making any investment decision. # **U.S. and Iran reach peace deal, Strait of Hormuz to reopen Friday**
President Donald Trump **[announced Sunday](https://substack.com/redirect/580b7dc6-e124-4fc6-bf3a-dd7fad851f23?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** evening that the United States and Iran have agreed to end their nearly four-month war, with a formal signing ceremony scheduled for Friday in Switzerland. The agreement calls for the immediate reopening of the Strait of Hormuz -- a critical artery carrying roughly 20% of global oil supply -- and the simultaneous lifting of the US naval blockade on Iranian ports. Pakistan and Qatar served as the primary intermediaries throughout negotiations after direct talks repeatedly stalled.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/580b7dc6-e124-4fc6-bf3a-dd7fad851f23?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **The deal 's key terms include Iran destroying its highly enriched uranium stockpiles,** pledging never to acquire nuclear weapons, cutting off funding to terrorist organizations including Hezbollah, and opening the strait upon signing. Economic sanctions relief will follow only after Iran completes verifiable steps toward denuclearization. The agreement will launch a 60-day negotiating period to finalize the broader framework.
* **The breakthrough nearly collapsed Sunday after Israel launched strikes on Hezbollah targets near Beirut,** infuriating Trump. The president reportedly confronted Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu directly by phone, demanding an explanation. Iran returned to the table after receiving assurances regarding US commitments, with negotiations continuing until approximately 5 p.m. ET Sunday before the deal was finalized.

subject: We Must Keep Talking About Trump’s Slush Fund
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ELIZABETH PANNILL FLETCHER FOR CONGRESS
body:
ELIZABETH PANNILL FLETCHER FOR CONGRESS [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP10/1/82676/images/Non-Re-Elect%20Logo.png]
The Republican-controlled Congress has spent more than a year rubber-stamping the Trump administration’s harmful policies. Now, Republicans are refusing to put guardrails on what could become a nearly $2 billion taxpayer-funded slush fund for President Trump.
This is not how government is supposed to work. And we must keep talking about it.
A federal judge in Virginia recently blocked any payouts or other work to establish the fund while legal challenges continue to move through the courts. The Department of Justice has since suggested that plans for the fund are not moving forward.
But nothing is set in stone.
When Senate Republicans had the opportunity to ban the fund, they chose not to. They didn’t even bother to put any guardrails on it. And President Trump certainly has not backed away from the idea.
In a recent interview, he said:
"I think the weaponization fund is a great idea, and so do many other Republicans. You have to get it approved. If they get it approved, that's great. If they don't get it approved, I'd be disappointed."
It's worth remembering how we got here.
President Trump's $10 billion lawsuit and the resulting settlement arrangement represent a troubling departure from how our justice system is supposed to function. Few Americans could have imagined a President suing the United States government, appointing his personal attorney to lead the Department of Justice, and settling that lawsuit by creating a fund that could direct nearly $2 billion in taxpayer dollars to him and his allies—with little transparency, oversight, or accountability—while shielding himself, his family, and family’s businesses from any future IRS audits. He has written himself a get-out-of-jail-free card.
The questions this situation raises are as serious. The potential for abuse is obvious. And the implications for public trust in government are profound.
We cannot afford to look away.
That's why we are continuing our work to elect Democrats in Texas and across the country who will fight for transparency, accountability, and responsible government. Taking back the House is essential. Every election matters, and the choices we make in 2026 will determine whether abuses of power continue unchecked or whether we impose the checks and balances that our democracy depends on.

In an effort to navigate President Donald Trump's erratic behavior during the indirect negotiations aimed at ending the war, Iran's negotiating team enlisted the help of psychiatric professionals to develop an assessment of the U.S. president's mental condition and to assist Iranian negotiators in crafting messages passed to Trump by regional mediators.
"We added two senior psychologists to the negotiations' advisory circle so that we can shape messages intended for President Trump from the perspective of managing what we regard as psychopathic behavior pattern," an Iranian official told Drop Site. He said the psychologists began assisting Iranian negotiators following the initial round of bilateral talks in Islamabad in April as the two sides began exchanging proposed terms for a potential Memorandum of Understanding.
"[Trump's] reactions have improved noticeably since we began incorporating the recommendations of these advisers into our messages and written communications," said the official, who was not authorized to speak publicly.
"Because the exchanged texts will ultimately become part of the historical record, we conduct our negotiations in a manner that ensures the relative weight and sophistication of each party's negotiating techniques will be evident should these communications be made public in the years ahead," the official added.
The Washington Post recently [reported](https://substack.com/redirect/b3fec008-d877-4944-a8db-5bfb908cd03b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that 22 medical specialists examined Trump as part of his latest checkup, saying it was "nearly double the number of specialists who assessed Trump for his past medical checkups as president." The report added that this "represents the most medical specialists to assess a president for a single visit."
On Sunday night, Trump and Iran announced that they had reached a preliminary agreement for a Memorandum of Understanding, to be signed in Geneva, Switzerland on June 19.

body:
| Peter,

Life has a funny way of putting hurdles in front of us. Some are the everyday kind, some are the big unexpected ones, and some, _in my case_ , were literal.

Back in high school, I ran track, and one of the events I competed in was hurdles. It ended up being a lot of fun, but I still remember how scary it felt the first time I ran the race at full speed. You sprint as fast as you can, and then you have to launch yourself over a rigid metal frame, trusting that you'll clear it instead of crashing into it and walking away with bruises.

The thing about hurdles is you can't stand there staring at them. You can't worry about the one after that, or the one after that. You just have to take them one at a time until you cross the finish line. Some hurdles are easier than others, and sometimes you clip one and have to catch your balance. _No matter what, you keep going._

I've found that campaigns are a lot like that. Every milestone matters, and every challenge we overcome brings us one step closer to where we're trying to go. **Right now, our campaign is running full speed toward the next hurdle in front of us: our $30,000 mid-month goal for June.**

Reaching this goal will help us build toward a record-breaking end-of-quarter FEC report and show everyone — from political pundits to the special interests backing Mariannette Miller-Meeks — that we have what it takes to win this race.

Will you make a contribution today to help us reach our $30,000 mid-month goal and keep our campaign moving forward? clean_body: | Peter, Life has a funny way of putting hurdles in front of us. Some are the everyday kind, some are the big unexpected ones, and some, in my case , were literal. Back in high school, I ran track, and one of the events I competed in was hurdles. It ended up being a lot of fun, but I still remember how scary it felt the first time I ran the race at full speed. You sprint as fast as you can, and then you have to launch yourself over a rigid metal frame, trusting that you'll clear it instead of crashing into it and walking away with bruises. The thing about hurdles is you can't stand there staring at them. You can't worry about the one after that, or the one after that. You just have to take them one at a time until you cross the finish line. Some hurdles are easier than others, and sometimes you clip one and have to catch your balance. No matter what, you keep going. I've found that campaigns are a lot like that. Every milestone matters, and every challenge we overcome brings us one step closer to where we're trying to go. Right now, our campaign is running full speed toward the next hurdle in front of us: our $30,000 mid-month goal for June. Reaching this goal will help us build toward a record-breaking end-of-quarter FEC report and show everyone — from political pundits to the special interests backing Mariannette Miller-Meeks — that we have what it takes to win this race. Will you make a contribution today to help us reach our $30,000 mid-month goal and keep our campaign moving forward? Unearthed audio has caught the GOP House Speaker admitting exactly what they talk about behind closed doors when they think you aren't listening. He didn't mince words. He laid it out clearly: **Medicare, Medicaid, and Social Security are the reasons "we're in trouble," and they have a plan to "adjust and fix" them next year.**
[](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/af20deda-4093-4869-aae5-71d1e9d59565?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Let's be entirely clear about what "adjust and fix" means in the language of career politicians and corporate donors. It means **cuts.** It means raising the retirement age, slashing benefits, and shrinking the lifelines that working-class Americans paid into with every single paycheck of their lives.
**The political class is already drawing up plans to slash your benefits next year. We need to build our defense right now.[Can you chip in $25 today to help us fight back against this Washington blueprint?](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/543c6815-9611-49ce-87e8-9bf2490dc455?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[Let's Pull a Win 2026!!](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/543c6815-9611-49ce-87e8-9bf2490dc455?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
The establishment loves to talk about "mandatory spending" and "entitlement programs" like it's charity. They treat the money that keeps our seniors alive and our families healthy like a corporate line item that needs to be trimmed to satisfy their donors.
That isn't their money to "fix." That is **your** money that **you** earned through decades of grit and hard work. While the legislature happily hands out billions in tax refunds to massive corporate conglomerates, they turn around and tell the working class that there "isn't enough" when it comes to basic human dignity.
### **The Rigged Map Makes Sense Now**
| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/8962bc8d-fd2e-40b0-9bed-f8789401fae2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
This is exactly why they were so desperate to redraw our district lines and silence your vote.
They know that if they have to run on a platform of gutting Social Security and cutting Medicare, they will lose every single time. So, they use gerrymandering as a shield. They try to carve up communities so they can protect career politicians from ever having to face real accountability from the people they are planning to rob.
**I am running for Congress because I refuse to let them play games with your survival.** I am committed to making sure working Americans are finally seen, heard, and protected from the corporate raiders in D.C.
**They have a plan for next year, but we have a plan for election day. Help us take the fight directly to the establishment.[Invest $25 today to fund our movement and protect our communities.](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/543c6815-9611-49ce-87e8-9bf2490dc455?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

### **We Are the Last Line of Defense**
They think because they have the gavel and the backroom deals, they can quietly dismantle the programs that lifted generations of Americans out of poverty. They think we aren't paying attention.
We need to send a clear message that our security is non-negotiable. I won't let them touch a dime of the benefits you earned, and I will always put hometowns over corporate headlines.
They want a budget cut. **Let 's give them an eviction notice.**

This is a rare moment — Flag Day, President Trump's birthday, and America's 250th year all landing at once. Here's what it means for Ohio. |
---
Peter,

There are moments that remind you exactly what you're fighting for. _**This is one of them.**_

Yesterday, June 14th — Flag Day — President Donald Trump turned 80 years old. And this year, that birthday falls inside America's 250th anniversary. A quarter-millennium of freedom, fought for and handed down, generation after generation.

I don't think that's a coincidence. _I think it's a reminder._

When President Trump stepped back onto the national stage, he wasn't just running for office. [**He was running to make sure that 250 years of American greatness didn't end on our watch.**](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=cced1e1c8da64b04b7b0bb911d8414b5&_e=m-eZzMXk6EGrnIiLrubQ-UO0TJJ6Kk_uQ0s81YrlEeDEOpuGVfgAvqqPkoaMsjTIeLWld7p4niQyqehluHVt3LP-gKFce7Id9EZIiRewwO8CInMfTuhNBlNjLKlcbfSQKzECxQDSpBhQdGOlpONrBpkhssBP9PgLK9f9VHL_LNSB6bhtuFlKEvnX9W0ucrsZ2HuRj6d88zlH2w8LpnelcvADw2Dla4Bh4e3O0Foh3FHkueqkwxTxDKXOycq6zhL5fg7XnT4pdVoq5TwxP5shGA5BY3KksdaeTPU8rAPxjZj1nfXIAhX0ilJ7YX5WyB9JucnlGHj9Ks-TrC3GSepmnRjPOhHa03imNB1jl9QHlC-SekGhicPYIXJArqBZ-ZHT1ZxOLJ9cdTRJdeAvy6ov16r2h35OS2CyUAG0ImCbC_sW_PJjWjwxm8dNZlOVwM7AXbHu5S-pojTUUugPBOqnuPXdzf0cqYuhzuyc6USoPD6O9yPUU6QQfX9_-PNxUyb-xScwoKv0Vb1NqwyifzOALu-zgRyGUsIjKNRxoXeG4UsekubdZ4MKjuUCIacoKcxDlOIrnTAk8XwIm1Dg76B7j1LPNHarSdgELy42-WmtBECO4w5SWPBHYGqETkitTEqvZGRU_k9I57-UVXHgWLQOl4BjvVX2ptpufC7GOpPxpzhvV1rYTJUZyEdk2UQRcqG_) Secure borders. clean_body: This is a rare moment — Flag Day, President Trump's birthday, and America's 250th year all landing at once. Here's what it means for Ohio. | Peter, There are moments that remind you exactly what you're fighting for. This is one of them. Yesterday, June 14th — Flag Day — President Donald Trump turned 80 years old. And this year, that birthday falls inside America's 250th anniversary. A quarter-millennium of freedom, fought for and handed down, generation after generation. I don't think that's a coincidence. I think it's a reminder. When President Trump stepped back onto the national stage, he wasn't just running for office. Secure borders. American energy. American pride. He didn't just talk about it — he delivered. And now, the same forces that tried to stop him are trying to take back the House. | If the Left flips seats like OH-15 this November, they don't just flip a district — they flip the gavel. Hakeem Jeffries gets the Speakership. And the America First agenda that's been delivering results for Ohio families gets buried. Peter, the patriotism we celebrate this week has to mean something beyond the holiday. It has to translate into action — in the voting booth, and right now, in the fight to keep our Majority. For Ohio and for America, Mike Carey Congressman, OH-15 P.S. The 250th celebration is a moment for the whole country. But the midterms in November will determine whether what we celebrate this year is protected or dismantled. Don't sit this one out. | | Paid for by Carey for Congress P.O. A Fox News poll shows me ahead in Ohio’s Senate race.
Peter –
The first public poll of the general election in Ohio was just released, and you need to take a look:

**The momentum behind our campaign is growing, but so is the target on our backs. Republicans can see we’re putting up a fight, and they’re going to do whatever it takes to stop us in our tracks.[Before I say more, can you split any amount between my campaign and Heartland Patriots so we can hit our $100K rapid response goal and take on whatever’s next?](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/105114?refcode=em20260615-10551&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=10551%2E614464%2Ei-7eCD)**
