name: Major General Paul Eaton, U.S. Army, retired
subject: Donald Trump just lost the Iran War
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY VOTEVETS, VOTEVETS
body:
#
Peter —
I spent a career leading Americans into harm’s way. The hardest decision in our Republic — whether to send them at all — the Constitution gives to Congress, the body closest to the people who do the dying, so that no one man can spend American lives on his own say-so.
This President spent them anyway. Thirteen Americans are dead and over three hundred wounded. Gas crossed four dollars a gallon — a dollar higher than the day before he started. We drained the missiles and interceptors we would need to deter China, stockpiles our own commanders say will take years to rebuild. The Strait of Hormuz, open before this war, was shut for the first time in its history. And the brutal regime in Tehran is stronger today than the day he attacked it.
And when the House voted on a bipartisan basis to rein him in, he called it “meaningless.” That is the truth of this man: he does not want to win the argument over war. He wants no argument at all. And he is not finished. He has already seized the head of state of Venezuela, and he muses openly about Cuba, about Greenland, about Mexico — boasting that “nobody can stop us.”
Well, someone must. That power is on the ballot in November. The most important thing the American people can do is elect a Democratic Congress with the spine to make him ask — and the votes to say no. Not a symbolic resolution he can wave away. One he cannot ignore.
That is the definitive objective of VoteVets, from this point until November. Our democracy itself is on the line, and all of us must do whatever we can to defend it.

Now let me tell you why this mission means so much to me. My name is Eduardo Verastegui. Several years ago, I learned firsthand about the horrific reality of child trafficking. What I heard broke my heart. Children were being bought and sold.
Families were being torn apart.
Lives were being destroyed. **I couldn't forget it.** **I couldn't stay silent.** I kept asking myself one question: **"What if it were my child?"** That question changed my life. What started as a film project became a mission and a calling. That calling eventually led me to help produce the film _Sound of Freedom_. **Not for fame.**
**Not for awards.**
**But because I believed people needed to see the truth.** For years, many people said the film would never succeed. Doors closed.
Studios walked away.
People told us to give up. **But when innocent children are suffering, silence is not an option.** And while the film helped awaken millions of people to this crisis, awareness alone is not enough. That is why we created the **Sound of Freedom Foundation**. Our mission is simple: **To stop the sale of God's children.**

Thank you. Thank you for caring about children you may never meet. Thank you for believing that every child has value and for refusing to accept a world where innocent children can be bought and sold. Because that is exactly what is happening. Every day. God's children are not for sale. And today, I'd like to send you a shirt that boldly declares that truth. When you make your first gift to the Sound of Freedom Foundation today, we'll send you a FREE white "God's Children Are Not For Sale" t-shirt as our thank-you. | | | | | | | | This isn't a shirt you'll find in a store. You can't buy it online. It was created exclusively for supporters of the Sound of Freedom Foundation. People who believe children deserve safety, refuse to look away and are willing to stand up and say: "No more." Every time you wear it, you'll be sharing a message that matters. A message that reminds the world that every child has God-given dignity. And importantly, a message that sparks conversations and helps raise awareness about a crisis many people still do not see. Most of all Friend, I hope this shirt reminds you that you are part of something bigger than yourself. A growing movement of people determined to protect vulnerable children. Please accept this shirt as our way of saying thank you for joining this mission. Give any amount today and choose your shirt size and select a color. Now let me tell you why this mission means so much to me. My name is Eduardo Verastegui. Several years ago, I learned firsthand about the horrific reality of child trafficking. What I heard broke my heart. Children were being bought and sold. Families were being torn apart. Lives were being destroyed. I couldn't forget it. I couldn't stay silent. I kept asking myself one question: "What if it were my child?" That question changed my life. What started as a film project became a mission and a calling. That calling eventually led me to help produce the film Sound of Freedom. Not for fame. Not for awards. But because I believed people needed to see the truth. For years, many people said the film would never succeed. Doors closed. Studios walked away. People told us to give up. But when innocent children are suffering, silence is not an option. And while the film helped awaken millions of people to this crisis, awareness alone is not enough. That is why we created the Sound of Freedom Foundation. Our mission is simple: To stop the sale of God's children. Every day, vulnerable children are targeted by traffickers who prey on poverty, instability, loneliness, and fear. And every day, we work to fight back. Jesus said, "Let the little children come to me, for the kingdom of heaven belongs to such as these." (Matthew 19:14) Every child is precious in God's eyes. Every child is created with dignity, purpose, and worth. And every child deserves someone willing to stand up and fight for them When you make your first gift today, you help: Prevent exploitation by helping strengthen vulnerable families before traffickers can prey on children. Choose your shirt size and select a color. And know that your generosity will help protect vulnerable children and bring hope to those who need it most. Thank you for caring and for standing with vulnerable children. Thank you for choosing action over silence. Hey Peter, Last month, Tennessee Republicans did something that has never been done in our state's history. They ordered a special session, redrew our congressional map in just three days, and surgically sliced Memphis – our state's largest city and only majority-Black congressional district – into three separate pieces. They did it to dilute Black voting power and erase our last Democratic congressional seat. **But then they did something even quieter, and far more dangerous:** They repealed the law that required election officials to mail you a letter when redistricting changes your polling place or precinct. No letter. No notice. Just a wiped-out district and a prayer that you show up to the wrong place on Election Day and give up. It’s voter suppression by design. Our fight is at the ballot box and we won’t give up. **We have a critical mid-month goal: $4,500 by Wednesday, June 17th, to stay on track for our end-of-quarter fundraising deadline. clean_body: Republicans changed the maps. Then they made sure you wouldn't find out. | = Hey Peter, Last month, Tennessee Republicans did something that has never been done in our state's history. They ordered a special session, redrew our congressional map in just three days, and surgically sliced Memphis – our state's largest city and only majority-Black congressional district – into three separate pieces. They did it to dilute Black voting power and erase our last Democratic congressional seat. But then they did something even quieter, and far more dangerous: They repealed the law that required election officials to mail you a letter when redistricting changes your polling place or precinct. No letter. No notice. Just a wiped-out district and a prayer that you show up to the wrong place on Election Day and give up. It’s voter suppression by design. Our fight is at the ballot box and we won’t give up. We have a critical mid-month goal: $4,500 by Wednesday, June 17th, to stay on track for our end-of-quarter fundraising deadline. = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | = = Republicans rigged the maps and rules because they’re terrified of what happens when every Tennessean’s vote counts equally. Let's show them they were right to be afraid. For Tennessee, Rachel Campbell Chair, Tennessee Democratic Party P.S. -TODAY is the last day to purchase an early bird individual ticket for our 2026 Annual 3-Star Dinner on Saturday, August 29th at the Music City Center in Nashville. Hi, Michele here.
I'm NOT in this for the fame.
I'm NOT in this for fortune.
I'm NOT in this to spend the rest of my life in politics.

name: Molly Gray
subject: 🚨BREAKING: VSEA Endorses Molly Gray
body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP10/1/80898/images/MG%20LOGO%20-WEB%20%281%29.png]
Dear Peter,
I’m proud to share some exciting news: The Vermont State Employees’ Association (VSEA) has endorsed my campaign for Lieutenant Governor.
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP10/1/80898/images/VSEA%20endorse%20%281%29.png]
VSEA represents more than 6,000 hardworking Vermonters across our state, spanning nine bargaining units — from state employees and corrections officers to judicial staff, defenders, state college employees, state’s attorneys’ staff, and more. They are the second-largest union by membership in Vermont.
I’m proud to have earned their support, and will always have their backs.
When state employee and teacher pensions were under threat in 2021, I stood with Vermont’s unions and spoke out against efforts to break a promise made to workers who had spent their careers serving our state. I always have and still do believe that a pension is a promise that should not only be made but kept .
Our state employees keep Vermont running every single day. They care for our communities, protect our public safety, support our state colleges, and deliver services Vermonters rely on.
If someone works hard for our state, they should be able to support their family, care for their loved ones, and retire with dignity.
As Lieutenant Governor, I’ll continue standing up for state employees, working families, and strong unions.
This campaign is building momentum — powered by grassroots supporters, organized labor, and Vermonters who believe in protecting fundamental rights, lowering costs, and making life better for working families.
Will you chip in today to help us reach our fundraising goals this month so we can keep building this movement and fight for policies that support Vermont’s working families? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mrg2026-em]

Peter,

Yesterday, our CO-01 primary challenger, Melat Kiros, was slated to have a
packed rally with activist Hasan Piker and fellow Justice Democrats
Donavan McKinney and Justin J. Pearson in Denver.

Then, all of the venues and vendors with big developer landlords cancelled
their contracts at the last minute, just days after the real estate lobby
started spending tens of thousands of Super PAC dollars to boost incumbent
Rep. Diana DeGette.

for All, universal childcare, housing for all, and an end to forever wars

A photograph posted to the Socialist Rifle Association shows Graham Platner's unmistakable ginger beard as he shields his pale skin from the scorching sun of the firing range.
Last October, _The Robinson Report_ broke the story that Graham Platner -- the disabled Sullivan veteran with an oyster hobby who is now the Democratic nominee for U.S. Senate -- had personally instructed members of the Socialist Rifle Association in firearms training in Maine.
Now, two additional accounts -- both from self-described left-wingers -- have surfaced that confirm Platner's top role in the Maine chapter of firearms and political activism org.
The reporting previously rested on Platner's own words, as well as pictures from an official Socialist Rifle Association (SRA) social media account that appeared to show Platner serving as a range officer for the group's training sessions.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/6b852d3f-018d-4b7e-97c5-0c463f86e49f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Graham Platner's SRA trainees display an Industrial Workers of the World flag. The IWW was founded in Chicago in 1905 by a coalition of radical unionists, socialists, anarchists, and Marxists, including figures like Bill Haywood and Eugene Debs.
Posting under the Reddit handle "P-Hustle," he wrote in August 2020 that his chapter ran "lots of range days, firearms education classes," that he'd "just put on a defensive handgun course two weekends ago," and that the group ran monthly introductory courses plus "more advanced classes for experienced members." In a separate post, he recruited a Mainer to the chapter directly: "We're quite active."
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/6bb2d692-08a3-4caa-83f1-921a633a43b1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/a9912582-a6a7-42e8-bdbd-0bd086b8b150?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/c27d9a27-c113-4702-b920-6acc10be3d2e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/03e5a7f1-c792-47c9-ba5a-b861ac66df8d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/e77fa176-fcf1-4b71-ae6e-a75d517c31eb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
On X, the far left gun club posted images from multiple training sessions showcasing members with blurred faces and an arsenal of firearms. The SRA blurs faces in the photographs, but some were insufficiently blurred -- including a red-haired, red-bearded man matching Platner.
The SRA also distributed material on how to subvert law enforcement surveillance of mobile phones and use "burner" phones.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/94722373-6390-46f2-b2e3-649296a620a5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Eight months later, two new accounts corroborate the original reporting from opposite directions -- one a grateful student, one a former Tinder fling who posted in alarm of a man with a Nazi tattoo who'd started a gun club in coastal Maine.
The new information confirms that Platner was not just member of the organization, but that he held a leadership role in the firearms training group.

Last week, a poster on r/portlandme published an [open letter](https://substack.com/redirect/a67a2393-86b6-4b49-8888-9a74164dca00?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of thanks titled "Graham Platner Taught Me How To Shoot A Handgun."
"Flashy title, I know," the post opens. The author describes being one of a number of "afraid queer folks" who sought self-defense training in 2020, and identifies Platner by name and role: "Graham was the officer, largely in charge, of the Maine branch of the SRA (Socialist Rifle Association)."
The second account is the more significant of the two -- because it is documented and time-stamped.
A left-wing streamer / cannabis-enjoyer using the X handle [@420mercymain69](https://substack.com/redirect/5d3dae85-c24f-46bc-aa69-82aa4cf76b2f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) came forward the day after Platner clinched the nomination, alleging she met him on Tinder in February 2021 and dated him through mid-July of that year.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/64256162-cad6-4005-9f8f-d1c37c483f55?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
She publicly shared screenshots of private messages -- including texts to her own mother -- describing Platner's chest tattoo as a "Nazi tattoo," along with a lengthy statement posted to X. The messages are dated September 26, 2025: before the Totenkopf became public knowledge but after Platner was making national headlines as a rising Democrat star. The messages were also sent before Platner went on _Pod Save America_ and falsely claimed that he had no idea the tattoo was anything other than a scary skull.
The X user says Platner told her he knew the tattoo was connected to Nazi death camps but that he kept it deliberately, "as a reminder that the United States was the evil, bad guy overseas."
That is a materially different story than the one Platner has told the public -- that he picked a skull off a wall in Croatia and never understood its meaning. The woman's account would add to the growing number of Democrats, [including a close personal friend of Platner's](https://substack.com/redirect/e9c03ba2-54c0-46b9-a77b-81dc1be1a07e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), who've confirmed that he has misled the public about his Nazi tattoo.
In other words, a private citizen with no political motive recorded Platner's self-knowledge of his tattoo's incontestable Nazi origins -- as well as his prominent role in the Maine SRA.
In a 2021 post from the same X account, the user bemoaned "toxic men in leftist spaces" and referred to a guy who "started an SRA chapter," adding, "omg I think he's a secret nazi I'm freaking out."
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/01f037e8-43f4-4b44-bbe7-f4b754775929?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
The woman also alleges that Platner stole her pie dish.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/32169a03-5d0e-4179-ac6d-b7792f9769c3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
#### Who the hell cares whether Platner was forming an armed group of political extremists and teaching them tactics he learned during a career in the U.S. military?
Maine Democrats, that's who. Including Maine CD-2 candidate and State Sen. Joe Baldacci (D-Penobscot).
As every media outlet in the state of Maine covered extensively, Baldacci led a 2024 campaign to ban the type of training Platner provided to socialists and communists.
LD 2130 was sponsored by Sen. Baldacci and passed both chambers in April 2024.
Yet not a single outlet in the state has covered Platner's role in running the very kind of organization his party prohibited.
Maine Democrats, with Baldacci among the loudest voices, hyperventilated over an imagined right-wing militia -- a right-wing militia that somehow was led by an [Andrew Yang fundraiser and a wacko who endorsed Joe Biden](https://substack.com/redirect/2f5a6967-dc8a-4313-94fa-8685f6b14f35?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
Baldacci wrote a law to make it a Class D crime to instruct another person in firearms if the intent is to cause "civil disorder."
[Share The Robinson Report](https://substack..AtQ1Uk0Rfow-ytht3qmfuTGpSpvCvF_Cwnp5mGWjA2E?)
Ironically, while Democrats were cheering a crackdown on imaginary paramilitary instruction, one of its rising stars was -- by his own posts and now by the accounts of two self-described leftists -- was teaching actual paramilitary tactics to an explicitly political, far left organization.
Right around the time the paramilitary ban passed the Maine legislature, the SRA quietly stopped posting images of its impressively armed training events, so there's no evidence that they continued to engage in paramilitary training after Maine law prohibited it. The group has never been connected to crimes of any sort in Maine.
Would the conduct depicted in SRA social media posts violate Badlacci's law?
The answer would hinge on whether the communists, socialists, and anarchists on the range aimed to create "civil disorder."
One sign of an intent to create civil disorder could be active planning to hide communication from law enforcement.

subject: Can you spare 2 quick minutes?
body:
| Peter, I can't believe you!
I've reached out to dozens of my top supporters, but you're the only one who took the time to read this text.
I have a message I need you to hear straight from me.

They are Tennessee problems. And they are exactly the problems that a congressman should be focused on solving.
That has been my track record as mayor. I did not run Columbia by picking fights online or chasing headlines. I ran it by showing up, listening, and getting things done for the people who sent me there. That is the same promise I am making to every voter in this new district.

Clarksville and Columbia. Franklin and Ripley. And a lot of places in between. And I want to tell you something: no matter where we go, we are hearing the same things. Gas prices are out of control. Groceries cost too much. Childcare is cost-prohibitive. Quality healthcare is out of reach. These are not Memphis problems or Martin problems or Clarksville problems. They are Tennessee problems. And they are exactly the problems that a congressman should be focused on solving. That has been my track record as mayor. I did not run Columbia by picking fights online or chasing headlines. A latte liberal and a self-described "Tea Party son of a bitch" walk into a bar with a bottle of tequila--and somehow it's one of the most honest hours in politics. Cliff and former Republican congressman Joe Walsh don't perform across-the-aisle civility; they actually like each other, and that's exactly why Joe says things out loud that almost nobody in his old party will. In this one, he names the former colleagues who told him to his face why they sold their souls to Trump--including the private confession Jim Jordan gave him--and admits the one ex-friend he still can't explain. Then he drops what a Republican strategist he still trusts whispered to him about a 2026 Senate candidate: that they're sitting on "reams" of opposition research they won't touch until after a specific ballot deadline.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuYmx1ZWFtcC5jby9zdWJzY3JpYmU_.ODevGB4XMY_nqAluG7yjc_9-FpnkXTxlU9cfAndwwOI?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=201643760)
From there it goes everywhere, the way only this show does--the performative-masculinity circus of Pete Hegseth and RFK Jr., who's really up in the battleground Senate map, and what both men actually want done with Donald Trump (it involves The Hague, a TV on a loop, and a fried chicken wing just out of reach). And then Cliff brings it home with the rant you came for: Trump stanking up Madison Square Garden, passing out at the game, and the New Yorkers who showed up to literally burn sage and break the curse. You don't want this one summarized. You want to watch it.

name: Hong for Wisconsin
subject: The speech that brought down the house
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Friends of Francesca Hong
body:
A better world begins here
# [](https://francescahong.com?refcode=em20260615-2914)
Peter,
The Democratic Party of Wisconsin wrapped up their statewide convention yesterday with candidate speeches, and we wanted to share the full text of Fran’s remarks.
Not only did she bring the house down, but she came in a close second in the straw poll–a sign that the same party insiders who once questioned her electability are coalescing to support her campaign.
[](https://act.francescahong.com/go/13954?t=1&akid=2914%2E105371%2EoIsil_)
**But before you read her vision for a better world, we need to be straight with you: We're facing the biggest fundraising deadline of the primary on June 30.**
We have real momentum and undeniable popular support from a broad coalition of Wisconsinites. But we need resources to take this fight all the way.
We're so grateful for our supporters. You're the reason we're here, and you'll be the reason we win this in August. And again in November.
**[Chip in today to make it happen. We’re almost there.](https://act.francescahong.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_fh_20260615.ol6dYl&refcode=em20260615-2914&t=2&akid=2914%2E105371%2EoIsil_)**
Now without further ado: Wisconsin’s next governor!
* * *
_Wisconsin is where environmentalism was born; where progressivism was born; where the Wisconsin Idea was born. This is the state of Vel Philips and Gaylord Nelson and Bob LaFollette; people before us who imagined a better world and fought like hell to realize it. These folks were called unreasonable, impractical – unelectable – and told that their ideas should be tempered by convenience. Yet today we look upon them as visionaries._
_Because possibility is bound only by our ambition. We must ask ourselves whether our conviction is once again strong enough to meet the demands of dangerous and desperate times._
_The past offers a warning. Democrats held a trifecta in 2010. They got complacent. And from that complacency came defeat. We cannot let this happen again._
_I am running on a platform of permanent affordability, not as a slogan, but as a practice. I’m the only candidate in this race who’s called for a moratorium on data center construction. I will not meekly accept a sellout of Wisconsin to trillionaires and tech corporations. I am the only candidate in this race with a plan for free childcare. I am the only candidate in this race who has even considered what AI means for our workers and our civil rights. And I am the only candidate in this race who takes income and power inequality seriously as the most urgent crisis of our time._
_And what we’re discovering is that when we address people’s material needs; when we acknowledge that they are right to feel screwed over, but that a better world is possible–they show up. Ours is a vision of a politics which has turned out thousands of people across Wisconsin – people that most campaigns don’t reach. These folks are knocking doors or organizing events for the first time because this is the campaign they see themselves reflected in. This campaign has earned their excitement._
_If we want to win, our politics must serve the mother who doesn’t get medical care because she can’t afford it and the stressed-out teacher whose rent increases but whose income doesn’t. It must serve the young couple caught between raising their children and paying their bills. And these people have chosen, overwhelmingly, our campaign._
_Because, listen, voters can smell bullshit. We can talk a lot of game about opposing Trump, but that’s not enough to win a trifecta. If we don’t build the power and organize the people required to deliver a better Wisconsin; if we don’t give people something they can believe in; we’ll go back to fighting for survival every single election. Our campaign is growing this coalition by the hour. Only with this vision and this long-term infrastructure do we have the chance to build the state Wisconsinites deserve. This is the promise unique to our campaign._
_The better world begins here. Resistance demands a vision in which regular people of all ages, races, genders, and faiths are included, are respected, are cared for; where our money and power are not given away to the wealthy but driven toward things that make all our lives better. We defeat Donald Trump–we drive a stake through the heart of fascism–not with rhetoric but by demanding, and winning, change at a speed and scale that matches the struggle of ordinary lives._
_In crises like these, diminishing our ambition is irresponsible. We must reject the cynicism and cruelty of the present for a greater imagination of the future–a future that can be won only if those we ask to fight with us see themselves within it._
_Folks: we can make better possible. We must make better possible. And, together, we will make better possible. My name is Francesca Hong, and it would be an honor to be your next governor. Thank you._
* * *

With gratitude,

But before you read her vision for a better world, we need to be straight with you: We're facing the biggest fundraising deadline of the primary on June 30. We have real momentum and undeniable popular support from a broad coalition of Wisconsinites. But we need resources to take this fight all the way. We're so grateful for our supporters. You're the reason we're here, and you'll be the reason we win this in August. And again in November. Now without further ado: Wisconsin’s next governor! Wisconsin is where environmentalism was born; where progressivism was born; where the Wisconsin Idea was born. This is the state of Vel Philips and Gaylord Nelson and Bob LaFollette; people before us who imagined a better world and fought like hell to realize it. These folks were called unreasonable, impractical – unelectable – and told that their ideas should be tempered by convenience. Yet today we look upon them as visionaries. Because possibility is bound only by our ambition. We must ask ourselves whether our conviction is once again strong enough to meet the demands of dangerous and desperate times. The past offers a warning. Democrats held a trifecta in 2010. They got complacent. And from that complacency came defeat. We cannot let this happen again. I am running on a platform of permanent affordability, not as a slogan, but as a practice. I’m the only candidate in this race who’s called for a moratorium on data center construction. I will not meekly accept a sellout of Wisconsin to trillionaires and tech corporations. I am the only candidate in this race with a plan for free childcare. I am the only candidate in this race who has even considered what AI means for our workers and our civil rights. And I am the only candidate in this race who takes income and power inequality seriously as the most urgent crisis of our time. And what we’re discovering is that when we address people’s material needs; when we acknowledge that they are right to feel screwed over, but that a better world is possible–they show up. Ours is a vision of a politics which has turned out thousands of people across Wisconsin – people that most campaigns don’t reach. These folks are knocking doors or organizing events for the first time because this is the campaign they see themselves reflected in. This campaign has earned their excitement. If we want to win, our politics must serve the mother who doesn’t get medical care because she can’t afford it and the stressed-out teacher whose rent increases but whose income doesn’t. It must serve the young couple caught between raising their children and paying their bills. And these people have chosen, overwhelmingly, our campaign. Because, listen, voters can smell bullshit. We can talk a lot of game about opposing Trump, but that’s not enough to win a trifecta. If we don’t build the power and organize the people required to deliver a better Wisconsin; if we don’t give people something they can believe in; we’ll go back to fighting for survival every single election. Our campaign is growing this coalition by the hour. Only with this vision and this long-term infrastructure do we have the chance to build the state Wisconsinites deserve. This is the promise unique to our campaign. The better world begins here. Resistance demands a vision in which regular people of all ages, races, genders, and faiths are included, are respected, are cared for; where our money and power are not given away to the wealthy but driven toward things that make all our lives better. We defeat Donald Trump–we drive a stake through the heart of fascism–not with rhetoric but by demanding, and winning, change at a speed and scale that matches the struggle of ordinary lives. In crises like these, diminishing our ambition is irresponsible. We must reject the cynicism and cruelty of the present for a greater imagination of the future–a future that can be won only if those we ask to fight with us see themselves within it. Folks: we can make better possible. We must make better possible. And, together, we will make better possible. My name is Francesca Hong, and it would be an honor to be your next governor. Thank you. With gratitude, Team Hong Email us: mailto:info@francescahong.com

name: Nico, United We Dream
subject: 14 years in, and a $555 fee still stands in the way
body:
Chip in to help cover the $555 renewal fee for every DACA recipient who comes to us for help. | | | Peter, For 14 years, DACA has provided life-changing protections, allowing us to work, study, and build our lives in the only country many of us have ever called home. Yet, it has also meant 14 years of living from one renewal to the next, never knowing when a court decision might strip these protections away. **Today, these protections face their greatest threat yet.** The DACA Renewal Fund covers the $555 application fee, ensuring no one loses their status due to financial hardship. We want to help everyone who comes to us, _but our waitlist is growing, and our funds are nearly depleted._ **[Will you rush a donation of $25, $50, or even the full $555 to the DACA Renewal Fund to help a DACA recipient renew? 100% of your tax-deductible donation will go directly into the hands of DACA recipients who need to renew their status.](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqvkqBZ6VW_VFbtBGGVx_RZ5NBR68cb1L0eV9EGWE5Hq_z7InR521VH9sm5eS6Q1snNstflo6iR0jMHVPPJymu1-TYiSU2xQldXziO3A7K9mq72WbIxht0zv9zpYUnHeQ8-JssgrizIjdCjib_vDOyU0W0xrKeffAj7v2Nwt6IQSRqsu_VnVvWaRXTk5fV41WKrlDuf_LFYiwPs2JMV5hMypUmaqxOQZMkZE0iVh05YvJ7txJ763nuYPq7GblelGes9v0whafT-9EbrV29VgHwGxRTvDz9JlzSTeekf8ejvuo-TXlyqmax4ErXa5GgujhTMkt9d1-PqSX-F0rVwbKS9hIlbpx-_9oLzVp21NON3hWuSbFKdTUtWBJCsqV8C0kYrX9tpRw0jbI0NwXa8nxhsAv0SMCRau66GAkuq7c-sdpQG6LoAyTcWNzHnnpq7qDYQ/4ri/Kjp599iZRWqkn-NuZl1wiw/h0/h001.vZ7i91fBj62ckvX5K7eH09J5AoUEOLLQh-YQt5kcnlw)** Renewing on time has never mattered more. Unprecedented delays are causing people to lose their jobs, income, and status.1 Furthermore, ongoing litigation threatens the right to work for DACA recipients in Texas.2 Court rulings are increasingly putting DACA recipients at risk of detention and deportation—even with valid status. We know of at least 340 detentions and 90 deportations. DACA has protected over 800,000 people from deportation, keeping millions of families together—including more than 250,000 U.S. citizen children with parents who have DACA. The average recipient arrived as a child and has lived here for decades; we have careers, families, and deep roots in our communities.3 Against this backdrop, renewing DACA remains the strongest form of protection. You have the power to make that happen for someone today. DACA was born out of courage and determination. When the odds seemed impossible, immigrant youth refused to be ignored and achieved the impossible. Fourteen years later, that same resolve moves us forward. **We will not let DACA fade quietly, and we will not let our community be pushed out of status.** The lasting answer is a pathway to citizenship—and we're calling on Congress to deliver it. **[Make no mistake: DACA has never been more vulnerable. clean_body: Chip in to help cover the $555 renewal fee for every DACA recipient who comes to us for help. | | | Peter, For 14 years, DACA has provided life-changing protections, allowing us to work, study, and build our lives in the only country many of us have ever called home. Yet, it has also meant 14 years of living from one renewal to the next, never knowing when a court decision might strip these protections away. Today, these protections face their greatest threat yet. The DACA Renewal Fund covers the $555 application fee, ensuring no one loses their status due to financial hardship. We want to help everyone who comes to us, but our waitlist is growing, and our funds are nearly depleted. Renewing on time has never mattered more. Unprecedented delays are causing people to lose their jobs, income, and status.1 Furthermore, ongoing litigation threatens the right to work for DACA recipients in Texas.2 Court rulings are increasingly putting DACA recipients at risk of detention and deportation—even with valid status. We know of at least 340 detentions and 90 deportations. DACA has protected over 800,000 people from deportation, keeping millions of families together—including more than 250,000 U.S. citizen children with parents who have DACA. The average recipient arrived as a child and has lived here for decades; we have careers, families, and deep roots in our communities.3 Against this backdrop, renewing DACA remains the strongest form of protection. You have the power to make that happen for someone today. DACA was born out of courage and determination. When the odds seemed impossible, immigrant youth refused to be ignored and achieved the impossible. Fourteen years later, that same resolve moves us forward. We will not let DACA fade quietly, and we will not let our community be pushed out of status. The lasting answer is a pathway to citizenship—and we're calling on Congress to deliver it. I am going to say this **once**.
Then I am **done** talking about her.
I have a district to serve. A war-funded thirty-year incumbent to defeat. Universal healthcare, housing, human dignity, civil liberties, climate, labor, and the rule of law to fight for. _That is where my energy belongs._
But when someone lies about my family--about my husband's torture, about my record on Palestine, about my lifelong commitment to marginalized communities--I will absolutely set the record straight. Once. Clearly. Then I will walk back into the work.
So here it is.
(If you prefer video: [TikTok](https://substack.com/redirect/d164a996-6f21-4dbd-8f5c-864102f8d4f7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), [Instagram](https://substack.com/redirect/d1d2c07d-7dd5-4772-ae4d-aeb4a08a6cfd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and [Facebook](https://substack.com/redirect/995ab29e-6322-4204-8c9b-26e9047e001b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).)
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/57c6b815-864a-4fc9-baf0-543a8c73f65b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
When my husband came home.
* * *
## On ICE terror
Kshama Sawant is out on the internet gaslighting you. Claiming that I "don't oppose ICE terror."
My honorable, decorated, disabled American veteran husband--in a wheelchair--was **abducted by ICE and tortured in solitary confinement** , then held in illegal detention for four months, away from our two little kids and me.
_**My**_**husband.**_**My**_**family.** Not hers.
I am the only candidate in this race with _lived family experience_ of ICE terror. I fought the weaponized federal government pro se across multiple jurisdictions against this travesty--**[and I won](https://open.substack.com/pub/melissa4congress/p/we-won-they-apologized-hes-coming?r=3zafez&utm_campaign=post-expanded-share&utm_medium=web)**. I know exactly what it means when the state takes someone you love, locks them away, violates their rights, and dares you to survive it.
So no. I will not be lectured on ICE terror by someone smearing the only candidate in this race who has _actually lived it_.
* * *
## On what it takes to win
She claims that because I understand it takes a team to pass legislation, I must be a sellout.
No.
That is not selling out. That is knowing how government works.
If you want universal healthcare--and I absolutely do--you need votes.
If you want affordable housing across the country--you need votes.
If you want to end U.S. support for foreign war crimes--you need votes.
If you want to stop ICE terror, protect civil liberties, defend workers, and reinvest money from war into our communities, you need a coalition strong enough to win and disciplined enough to govern.
That is not weakness. That is seriousness.
* * *
## On Palestine
She falsely accuses that I have sold out my love for justice and peace for Palestine for political gain.
No.
I have marched for Palestine _pregnant_ , pushing my disabled husband's wheelchair, our toddler on his lap, up and down Seattle hills, because I believe our government's support for a foreign government's violence was and remains morally indefensible.
[Aysenur Ezgi Eygi](https://substack.com/redirect/f9762101-7067-4c36-9c64-d98fd97a8592?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) babysat our little daughter while I spoke to a standing ovation at the University of Washington. When she was murdered, I prayed at her funeral.
I am friends with [Rachel Corrie](https://substack.com/redirect/fe067c92-d358-464b-be2b-8cc46e7905a1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)'s parents. My husband has known them for more than twenty years. Rachel's journals shaped my life--I read them when I was fifteen.
I will not allow anyone who was _not_ walking those hills with my family and what felt like half of Seattle to erase the fact that we were there.
Where was she?
* * *
## On marginalized communities
She is blatantly lying that I have somehow abandoned marginalized and disenfranchised communities for personal gain.
Absolutely not.
I have been a lifelong ally of marginalized people. Ask anyone who [actually knows me (Abba, Cortni)](https://substack.com/redirect/fdb0ac59-5d38-4287-b410-db610f225657?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Because equality, liberty, and justice for all means _all_ --no asterisks attached. **None**.
I was a founding member of the Gay Straight Alliance in high school, back when we had to hide the location of our meetings.
I have dear friends who are trans, LGBTQIA+, otherwise marginalized and under attack by this regime. I know what bigoted and racist power does when nobody stops it. I know what it means to fight systems that are bigger than you. I know what it means to be dismissed, targeted, underestimated, dehumanized, and told to wait your turn--or better yet, to disappear.
And I know what it takes to win for people anyway.
* * *
## On war
She claims I don't oppose war.
I am the _**only**_ candidate in this race whose family has paid the costs of war.
My father built his groundbreaking career in Navy medicine. My husband served honorably in the U.S. Army. Both were injured through their service. Both are disabled to this day.
**I paid for the Iraq and Afghanistan wars in family separation.** In my father's PTSD. In my husband's wheelchair. In shocking grief and betrayal at my country's complicity in atrocity. I paid in moral and emotional trauma.
Which is why _I have been a peace activist my whole life._
So no. I will not be lectured on war by someone trying to erase my record and my life because it is politically convenient to her.
* * *
## On her record
Kshama Sawant served in a Seattle City Council district that is a tiny fraction of a Congressional district. Even in that, she barely survived a recall vote.
She backstabbed her friends and supporters. Unions that supported her campaign eventually withdrew their support.
Last year, at a critical time, she attacked Zohran Mamdani on a public interview during his primary race, smearing among other things that he "wasn't a fighter for working people."
She is running as an independent socialist, but the DSA--the Democratic Socialists of America--would not even endorse her. Why? Because she has been trash-talking them and their candidates for years.
She cannot keep a coalition.
Kshama has betrayed LGBTQ communities time and again, including by endorsing Trump's win in 2024 just to punish Democrats. People have not forgotten.
She betrays and puts down her own volunteers. I have been hearing this for years, and was just reminded the other day by several state legislators that Kshama Sawant cannot be trusted. She will stab in the back the people who agree with her policy stances 90 percent. Then, when people back away, she will cry about "solidarity."
* * *
## What people are telling me
I am not the only one who has seen this pattern.
> "All Kshama leaves in her wake are burned bridges and distressed and angry former co-workers, as in the Seattle City Council. We don't need that in Congress. We have positive and very serious changes to make, and need sound ethics and determination, not ego and a distorted sense of entitlement."
> "I feel for Melissa Chaudhry. Kshama Sawant is an irresponsible bully and a divisive person. She deliberately foments conflict wherever she is. She is obnoxious and I do not think she has goodwill in her heart or good motivations for positive change, or is mature enough to take on this position."
> "Sawant does not actually care about LGBTQ rights at all. She actively wanted Trump to win to teach Kamala and Biden a lesson. She actively encouraged voters in swing states to vote Trump. Call her out on that."
> "She also, at an event at the detention center in support of your husband while he was held there, made a really long speech all about promoting herself and her campaign. The organizers specifically begged people to not speak longer than three minutes, but she went on and on, as many waited in the boiling heat for their turn to speak. Sawant only cares about Sawant. She's a grifter out for herself."
Public proof of these statements is here: [https://www.facebook.com/share/p/18sSwLXT77/](https://substack.com/redirect/fdb0ac59-5d38-4287-b410-db610f225657?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* * *
## She cannot win this district in November
This is what is happening.
People in this district want Adam Smith gone.
But many of them will _**never, ever**_ vote for Kshama Sawant. They tell me that over and over again.
And all those people are supporting _my_ campaign.
Which means my candidacy is _real representation_.
Washington's 9th is one of the most diverse districts in the country. Immigrants. Renters. Workers. Veterans. Muslims. White families. Black families. South Asian families. East African communities--Somali, Ethiopian, Eritrean. Christians. Jewish families. Hindu. Sikh. Yemeni. Algerian. Filipino families. Small-business owners. Union households. Vietnamese, Chinese, Thai, Russian, Ukrainian, Turkish, Iraqi, Afghan communities. Parents. Elders. Children of all origins, belonging here, believing in America's promise, trying to survive.
This district needs someone who can build a _majority_ here. Not just make a point nationally. Not just carry a banner.
Win here. Represent here.
* * *
## On the real spoiler
Yes, there is real grief in this. Two strong candidates with overlapping values should not have to split the field while a war-funded thirty-year incumbent benefits. I would dearly love Washington to have ranked-choice voting, so that voters' second and third choices could count.
But with the structure we have, the real spoiler in this race is not a challenger giving voters another path. That is called democracy in action.
The real spoiler is Adam Smith.
The thirty-year incumbent who has actively blocked new leadership while taking campaign money from the same forces harming our communities.
* * *
## Who I am
I have been an undocumented immigrant before. I have lived for years without status, without a job, without a bank account, without healthcare, without a driver's license--in Canada, in a marriage that I was trapped in, that turned toxic and abusive and that I barely escaped with my life.
Domestic violence survivors? Immigrant communities? Housing-insecure single mothers?
I see you. I feel you. I have been you.
I have been asked, encouraged, supported, _begged_ to run this campaign by people who are certain their lives would be better off with my lived experience in Congress representing their true values.
I am a pro se federal litigator familiar with fighting facism and winning. I am part of a veteran family. I am a mother of small children, from a mixed-race, mixed-status, mixed-ability, minority family--who has invested twenty years of my life on five continents learning what it _actually_ takes to ensure dignity, safety, and opportunity for all. In cooperative economics. In climate resilience. In food systems. In ecological infrastructure. In true and meaningful democracy.
**I can be the bridge from the nightmare we are in to the future we know is possible and desperately need.**
I am running a pro-peace, grassroots-funded, constitutional Democrat campaign against the top Democrat on the House Armed Services Committee.
I stand for:
* Universal healthcare
* Housing
* Human rights everywhere, including Palestine
* American sovereignty
* Civil liberties
* Climate
* Labor
* Prosecution of the Epstein files
* The rule of law

That is not small history.
* * *
## The truth
When you see her smears, understand what they are.
They are not truth. They are her fears.
Because the truth is simple: People who are done with Adam Smith deserve a candidate who can actually win this district.
That is why I am running.
* * *
## A note on the primary math
Remember this: if neither Sawant nor I make it through the primary, people will add our numbers together and say, "If only!"
But the truth is, **many people who vote for me would** _**never**_**have voted for her.**
Remember that.
* * *
## Now, back to work
I have said what I needed to say. The record is straight. My family's truth is on the record. The receipts are here.
I will not live in her drama. I do not have the time, the energy, or the interest. There is a district to represent, an incumbent to defeat, and a future to build.
So I am turning back to what actually matters.
**We the People.**
**Liberty and Justice for All.**
**Dignity, safety, and opportunity for all.**
**Care. Courage. The Constitution.**
Let's go win this thing.
-- Melissa

East African communities--Somali, Ethiopian, Eritrean. Christians. Jewish families. Hindu. Sikh. Yemeni. Algerian. Filipino families. Small-business owners. Union households. Vietnamese, Chinese, Thai, Russian, Ukrainian, Turkish, Iraqi, Afghan communities. Parents. Elders. Children of all origins, belonging here, believing in America's promise, trying to survive. This district needs someone who can build a majority here. Not just make a point nationally. Not just carry a banner. Win here. Represent here. On the real spoiler Yes, there is real grief in this. Two strong candidates with overlapping values should not have to split the field while a war-funded thirty-year incumbent benefits. I would dearly love Washington to have ranked-choice voting, so that voters' second and third choices could count. But with the structure we have, the real spoiler in this race is not a challenger giving voters another path. That is called democracy in action. The real spoiler is Adam Smith. The thirty-year incumbent who has actively blocked new leadership while taking campaign money from the same forces harming our communities. Who I am I have been an undocumented immigrant before. I have lived for years without status, without a job, without a bank account, without healthcare, without a driver's license--in Canada, in a marriage that I was trapped in, that turned toxic and abusive and that I barely escaped with my life. Domestic violence survivors? Immigrant communities? Housing-insecure single mothers? I see you. I feel you. I have been you. I have been asked, encouraged, supported, begged to run this campaign by people who are certain their lives would be better off with my lived experience in Congress representing their true values. I am a pro se federal litigator familiar with fighting facism and winning. I am part of a veteran family. I am a mother of small children, from a mixed-race, mixed-status, mixed-ability, minority family--who has invested twenty years of my life on five continents learning what it actually takes to ensure dignity, safety, and opportunity for all. In cooperative economics. In climate resilience. In food systems. In ecological infrastructure. In true and meaningful democracy. I can be the bridge from the nightmare we are in to the future we know is possible and desperately need. I am running a pro-peace, grassroots-funded, constitutional Democrat campaign against the top Democrat on the House Armed Services Committee. I stand for: Universal healthcare Housing Human rights everywhere, including Palestine American sovereignty Civil liberties Climate Labor Prosecution of the Epstein files The rule of law That is not small history. The truth When you see her smears, understand what they are. They are not truth. They are her fears. Because the truth is simple: People who are done with Adam Smith deserve a candidate who can actually win this district. That is why I am running. A note on the primary math Remember this: if neither Sawant nor I make it through the primary, people will add our numbers together and say, "If only!" But the truth is, many people who vote for me would neverhave voted for her. Remember that. Now, back to work I have said what I needed to say. The record is straight. My family's truth is on the record. The receipts are here. I will not live in her drama. I do not have the time, the energy, or the interest. There is a district to represent, an incumbent to defeat, and a future to build. So I am turning back to what actually matters. We the People. Liberty and Justice for All. Dignity, safety, and opportunity for all. Care. Courage. The Constitution. Let's go win this thing. -- Melissa You 're currently a free subscriber to "It's a Matter of Integrity" by Melissa Chaudhry. But if you take a closer look at his record, a different picture emerges. Before entering Congress, David Trone built a fortune as the co-founder of Total Wine. Today, he's a billionaire who has spent enormous sums trying to buy political office. And throughout his political career, one question keeps coming up: Who is David Trone really looking out for? While families across Maryland are worried about rising grocery prices, housing costs, and making ends meet, Trone has spent years leveraging his wealth, political connections, and influence to advance his own ambitions. He's donated to politicians across the political spectrum—including Republicans and right-wing elected officials—whenever it suited his interests. He's spent millions trying to climb the political ladder. And now he's asking voters to send him back to office once again. **At a young age, I joined the United States Marine Corps to defend our country and ultimately earned the rank of Sergeant before my discharge.** Once I entered civilian life, I started my entrepreneurial career owning a successful small computer business until my son took over the family business.

**Since the Democrats will want to use this to attack me, I will tell you: I was a former Democrat.** I switched over to the Republican Party during the Reagan era once I saw what the Democrats truly stood for. I’ve seen firsthand how today’s Democratic Party has abandoned working families. Every single day, I hear from constituents who are struggling with everyday challenges. I hear them, and I fully agree with them. It’s time for change in California.

**In short, my son, Nicholas, was tragically stabbed to death and murdered in 2016.**

If you’re a parent, I’m sure you could imagine how devastating this was for me. Nicholas was only 28 at the time and did not deserve what happened.

He had followed in my footsteps and joined the Marine Corps. He was a father to two children – my grandchildren. When it happened, no one came forward with any information, and the case to find the killer went cold.

**I decided to take a stand, to fight for the rule of law and public safety so that no other family has to experience the same tragedy.** Five years later, I ran for City Council in Hemet. I won, and just a few months later, our amazing law enforcement found the killer and arrested him.

**As a Hispanic American who lives in a border district and who was adopted by American parents, I fully believe in LEGAL immigration.** America is THE BEST COUNTRY IN THE WORLD! Millions of people around the world want to move here for the American Dream, for the opportunity of a better life, but they must do it THE RIGHT WAY.

**Our Southern Border has been porous under Joe Biden’s Administration.** Living in a border district, I’ve seen firsthand millions of illegal immigrants entering the country with the help of the dangerous Mexican Cartel, many through my hometown, bringing dangerous drugs like fentanyl, trafficking women and children, and committing heinous crimes on our side of the border. This needs to END, and I’m grateful for President Trump’s leadership on this. In Congress, I’ll always defend strong border security.

**On top of that, I am a firm believer in the America-First Movement.** After four years under Joe Biden’s leadership, America has become weak in every aspect. I already mentioned our border security, but our military, social life, and economy have all become weakened under the rule of DEI and wokeness.

**As a military veteran, it pained me to see the way Joe Biden withdrew from Afghanistan, giving the Taliban millions of dollars worth of high-level American military equipment, which they parade around.** Our weakened military presence allowed Russia to invade Ukraine and Hamas to launch terrorist attacks on Israel. I’ll do everything in my power as a Congressman to support our military so we prioritize READINESS over WOKENESS.

**Finally, we must dismantle DEI in every corner of the government.** DOGE’s work to cut wasteful spending has been a great start, but we must continue to fight to lower the cost of living, defend free speech, and usher in the Golden Age of America.

**Simply put – the Radical Left has a stranglehold on California.** Just like they’re trying to flip Texas Blue, I’m trying to flip California Red. It may seem impossible, but so many Californians are sick and tired of suffering under Gavin Newsom, Nancy Pelosi, and Adam Schiff’s leadership here. I know many people who have left California just because of the politicians who want to turn our beautiful state into a Communist Utopia.

**But Newsom, Pelosi, and Schiff have MILLIONS of dollars in reserve, ready to spend against my campaign to prevent common sense leadership.** They only care about lining their own pockets, even if their constituents suffer. _It’s going to be an uphill battle, but if there’s one thing I learned as a Marine, it’s that the only way to create a better tomorrow is through dedicated hard work and grit. Together, we can fight and WIN._

Meet Joe Males:

**Joe Males is a Marine Veteran, small business-owner, city council member, and most importantly, a father. Throughout his life, he has put service to his community at the forefront of his life’s mission.

Shortly after turning 18, Joe enlisted in the Marine Corps. He attended boot camp in Camp Pendleton and later served overseas in the Philippines and Guam. After being discharged as a Sergeant, Joe remained committed to supporting his fellow veterans. He took on leadership roles in his local Elks Lodge and American Legion post, working to ensure veterans in the community had the resources and support they deserved.

Following his time in the Marine Corps, Joe carried his strong work ethic and discipline into the field of computer networking services. He started in an entry-level position, worked his way through multiple leadership roles, and in 1996, he built his own business from the ground up. Joe knows firsthand the hard work and sacrifice of this journey, and he’s determined to make it easier for hardworking Americans to do the same.

Joe’s entry into politics was deeply personal. After his son, a Marine who followed in his footsteps, was tragically murdered back home, Joe vowed that no parent should have to endure such a loss. Determined to take a stand for public safety and the rule of law, he ran for Hemet City Council to help ensure no other family would experience the same tragedy.

During his tenure on the City Council, Joe has led numerous initiatives to improve infrastructure, drive business growth, and keep neighborhoods safe and clean. He takes pride in his ability to collaborate with fellow council members and get results, even when facing different perspectives. Joe is committed to bringing this same results-driven approach to Washington D.C., to ensure the voices of the American people are heard and their needs are met.

They only care about lining their own pockets, even if their constituents suffer. It’s going to be an uphill battle, but if there’s one thing I learned as a Marine, it’s that the only way to create a better tomorrow is through dedicated hard work and grit. Together, we can fight and WIN. | Thank you for taking the time to read all of this. I truly appreciate it. Semper Fidelis, Joe Males Meet Joe Males: Joe Males is a Marine Veteran, small business-owner, city council member, and most importantly, a father. Throughout his life, he has put service to his community at the forefront of his life’s mission. Shortly after turning 18, Joe enlisted in the Marine Corps. He attended boot camp in Camp Pendleton and later served overseas in the Philippines and Guam. After being discharged as a Sergeant, Joe remained committed to supporting his fellow veterans. He took on leadership roles in his local Elks Lodge and American Legion post, working to ensure veterans in the community had the resources and support they deserved. Following his time in the Marine Corps, Joe carried his strong work ethic and discipline into the field of computer networking services. He started in an entry-level position, worked his way through multiple leadership roles, and in 1996, he built his own business from the ground up. Joe knows firsthand the hard work and sacrifice of this journey, and he’s determined to make it easier for hardworking Americans to do the same. Joe’s entry into politics was deeply personal. After his son, a Marine who followed in his footsteps, was tragically murdered back home, Joe vowed that no parent should have to endure such a loss. Determined to take a stand for public safety and the rule of law, he ran for Hemet City Council to help ensure no other family would experience the same tragedy. During his tenure on the City Council, Joe has led numerous initiatives to improve infrastructure, drive business growth, and keep neighborhoods safe and clean. He takes pride in his ability to collaborate with fellow council members and get results, even when facing different perspectives. Joe is committed to bringing this same results-driven approach to Washington D.C., to ensure the voices of the American people are heard and their needs are met. When fear takes over, Molly brings comfort, trust, and the first steps toward healing.

| | | Peter, A child who has been trafficked often learns a heartbreaking lesson: **Don't trust anyone. **
**Not adults.**
**Not authority figures.** Not even the people trying to help. That is one of the many reasons I am writing to you today. My name is Eduardo Verastegui. I am the producer of the film _Sound of Freedom_ and founder of the Sound of Freedom Foundation. After learning firsthand about the horrors of child trafficking, I dedicated my life to helping protect vulnerable children and supporting efforts to stop this evil. Over the years, I have met brave men and women who dedicate their lives to rescuing children from trafficking and exploitation. They walk into places most of us could never imagine. They investigate crimes no human being should ever have to see. They sit with children whose innocence has been stolen. And they carry those memories with them. **Day after day.**
**Year after year.** **That burden is heavy. **
---
[ Give Now. Bring Comfort.](http://links.standingstrongamerica.com/u/click?_t=29c3b6e742c849fabbcc130432510e66&_m=75a59beabe654dd3bcf98d8fd593f587&_e=2HaakOZe0RslJ95NTs_4uwT_hF4D1w-PbQzxhYxGZq1_2lnYui9V6zcnAx9h3mFRRCCuXRQe5M-Mx-IV4eSCzXP1rR7Cxt2LCCmJh_CsmRLZriCjTP-B-JA0GaBTMPvH2LiW3A4yIaw9moTAkw2ENFx5Lhprttt-txK2xfIo1fLiRaiAEdIElTSjIZuMCRfguFuBD5HO1_qtMJOsQWk-3NhiHgMvBvFVmNZIuGzFGm6uPmdJdEF1cmdbu6Df0ygvj_N5SVc6g2KSxI2Py6M8elIKqK5xb_HEhVH0LrxJYSXNwKaVP4FddIBP_FnVwkli7HWEcL7RtsDhKPVbnlt7U7i9wnrEVC8Amh4ZLRSEIUaBE6wdSC5lRnc--6vhK1jDeJ9czSJMsOSocM9r1dT72aVZy0qRKbmV8LEJ6h0n5kvLqsjv4emh2ycFCPc7R1gnQ-5wDlOk_4-c7AVDJEQepSbsvk05L-xgdYEVz0NL1MBsWV1bYyxgYd15eEm4UeCbcN4Tp78rsJmtuJmB93l114KNrQ00s4FeWEzFIHEPZhUQWDj3puAKJ16A9_CF24v8Yif-vFLeJhg7BAGb0w9CwBD6s2-PmRkqeXenR8zIM-Le4GrjmAqwnQobUY7nDpXfI03kb1eBVxej1hhNaji48NxaDMqz2DabcDkbEpPhPHrqdcmazR2bhlBzy1Q5G7r74Aybl-JJvmmSy10tU9XzMzsBsRQek0CckvLFKbm0wY30_S_q178wOzeyMEuJ54je)

Sometimes heavier than words can describe. And that is why I want you to meet someone very special. Her name is **Molly.**
---
[](http://links.standingstrongamerica.com/u/click?_t=29c3b6e742c849fabbcc130432510e66&_m=75a59beabe654dd3bcf98d8fd593f587&_e=2HaakOZe0RslJ95NTs_4uwT_hF4D1w-PbQzxhYxGZq1_2lnYui9V6zcnAx9h3mFRRCCuXRQe5M-Mx-IV4eSCzXP1rR7Cxt2LCCmJh_CsmRLZriCjTP-B-JA0GaBTMPvH2LiW3A4yIaw9moTAkw2ENFx5Lhprttt-txK2xfIo1fLiRaiAEdIElTSjIZuMCRfguFuBD5HO1_qtMJOsQWk-3NhiHgMvBvFVmNZIuGzFGm6uPmdJdEF1cmdbu6Df0ygvj_N5SVc6g2KSxI2Py6M8evw_bSA4Nd80rXc2ubzccDbEi4FRt5isx8fA-MS2DoSuE1faYfsnoGH2nCK08KJahyrndkrIuuNEm2ttOWxwb0N1b0Y2Wmmw-T2HFsFN1-c2YiLUpfcM45s_7SqB_Bg1Zv-gqfCQKTsm3PqDKd5b_nBj0B6GGNlXh5k2GQgqFyynNUSS9ELkVP-G8PoK2oeIkN4CeHCTE77Q_2ftyaYweKiJ_4BeE0F80aHlFpoLdXVI0yuX54kpzscOmax-yH0ZzFLTDvHEPgDuc1zmduvI_C7EWqxJ9FMm7moiXekdVHbQGKR906F2bMs9aqUF7gehdpw6FPeNEMOvb6KSmI85lXx9jkX2pmieAkOGFP96vrzZLC1kNoCj4Np8ltutSOXlpTfmEGibhnq5gwcQiV-MQEVBBqIlQSX9U5kNZNea56x4bCX0-syGflwB1zvn3dr_2srKa-9uVVFcMUk_QNZuogD3zWXYmMBsU9gaa0W8YYRA)
---
**Molly** is a Labradoodle. But to the officers, investigators, and rescued children she serves, she is so much more than a dog. **She is a source of comfort.**
**A source of peace.**
**A source of healing.** When an officer has spent hours working a difficult trafficking case, when they've witnessed evil no person should ever have to witness and the weight of the day feels almost unbearable...**Molly** quietly walks over. She leans against them.
And she stays. **She does not ask questions.**
**She does not need explanations.** **Her presence alone reminds them they are not carrying this burden by themselves. **Sometimes that simple moment is enough to help someone breathe again.
---
[ Give Now. Bring Comfort.](http://links.standingstrongamerica.com/u/click?_t=29c3b6e742c849fabbcc130432510e66&_m=75a59beabe654dd3bcf98d8fd593f587&_e=2HaakOZe0RslJ95NTs_4uwT_hF4D1w-PbQzxhYxGZq1_2lnYui9V6zcnAx9h3mFRRCCuXRQe5M-Mx-IV4eSCzXP1rR7Cxt2LCCmJh_CsmRLZriCjTP-B-JA0GaBTMPvH2LiW3A4yIaw9moTAkw2ENFx5Lhprttt-txK2xfIo1fLiRaiAEdIElTSjIZuMCRfguFuBD5HO1_qtMJOsQWk-3NhiHgMvBvFVmNZIuGzFGm6uPmdJdEF1cmdbu6Df0ygvj_N5SVc6g2KSxI2Py6M8ekpP-S5ko1lH0_stf7Nl0kWaphSMRNgguaHfoLvcksj2DWl6v3QOMvztV4ZGcpTZ_e1y8mQNkIlwzYggg27LEtAEvTlpFo2vJLkn58-b7ySmH52MmgUyECbDJtH73qcZL8vCn4uvJ_aW6QSpm6x99_5A3aBeeRXpJcnCJJID3KdQprOQQMq5RCOE3hkEo1uBx_FAhUByvquv0tH2mxNfgT_98-lfil6J7d7X_EbVzwAYOPykbUSPsAG7Yb551-M8HU8hetBIpSnXbHqroZCP9KiZdYankzVsPyaYPs_-iozoCqaEuKdFLAo2ysEVH1CjrlBnwSFCk8vI8SZrWmKF6xlz0oqRVYKfNDN5B0sjZyi2--peQCdMtv6pnggHUI95zGWQxTLhMPm5n8sWY1kozXYCM95ajg_9N4edObl4-cOzmnftYzVy6vFHbos_Qbesd6saupucHqxalIRx5NM1ePMwryJh9nsr5zl1VUFXkWms)
---
But **Molly's** work does not stop there. Some of the children rescued from trafficking are terrified, confused, and broken. Many have been manipulated for so long that they do not immediately trust the people trying to help them. Imagine that. Rescue has arrived. But trauma has taught them to fear everyone. **Then Molly enters the room.** No uniform. No questions. No pressure. **Just gentleness and love.**
---
[](http://links.standingstrongamerica.com/u/click?_t=29c3b6e742c849fabbcc130432510e66&_m=75a59beabe654dd3bcf98d8fd593f587&_e=2HaakOZe0RslJ95NTs_4uwT_hF4D1w-PbQzxhYxGZq1_2lnYui9V6zcnAx9h3mFRRCCuXRQe5M-Mx-IV4eSCzXP1rR7Cxt2LCCmJh_CsmRLZriCjTP-B-JA0GaBTMPvH2LiW3A4yIaw9moTAkw2ENFx5Lhprttt-txK2xfIo1fLiRaiAEdIElTSjIZuMCRfguFuBD5HO1_qtMJOsQWk-3NhiHgMvBvFVmNZIuGzFGm6uPmdJdEF1cmdbu6Df0ygvj_N5SVc6g2KSxI2Py6M8euyznoS2PgGOGYqAKTHEp5zsY79UDde0g5L_lEHO_SxSGdxF_E8PRkMI4Ht4tTRo-nINKlvuaL7kl77wrCprQSsOwsn5aWACgeL23CFtfT6Od6DCGQvaIL8dVOhE_i51fyYzdMbzoi8AcspfTchjK9aYU5pz2YhMU34IHARmc4T6X78dg8vBtlPY-7Issow6LNrSjYaCVah8yfhBim7Mjy2zXebuO7afLcjIm40yDBVZn7sDNx39eT2itOB3h_9bmQKKLSEKEH9BsLK0W5LhWV0SO7D2QGYK5BLu5v8uQqj5HTLbv_wNIQ4LaeCOnFwKb4Egpy5-4ssQ5s_9ZjiEGvNZHwlofT-7HhJhMwNlSfnz6tzL967KNJ7KsKXG_kK1dt0e8r7XjVVo1ElMrFxYUkwzWru_8Hvdy1azo5QcBKZEDkTSLpWQygmhIFOfqDW63MCqylZa8z0qEh04Vm6c3zOf-DEblNDQ-bU57Kqsf9iZ)
---
And somehow, walls begin to come down. Small hands reach out. Tears begin to flow. Fear begins to soften. **And healing can begin.** **That healing does not happen by accident.** It happens because one of our trusted anti-trafficking partners walks alongside survivors and the agencies that serve them.

They provide trauma-informed support, resources, and advocacy for lives shattered by trafficking.

Every day, they help children move from fear to freedom, from exploitation to safety, and from hopelessness to renewed hope.
---

Bring Comfort.](http://links.standingstrongamerica.com/u/click?_t=29c3b6e742c849fabbcc130432510e66&_m=75a59beabe654dd3bcf98d8fd593f587&_e=2HaakOZe0RslJ95NTs_4uwT_hF4D1w-PbQzxhYxGZq1_2lnYui9V6zcnAx9h3mFRRCCuXRQe5M-Mx-IV4eSCzXP1rR7Cxt2LCCmJh_CsmRLZriCjTP-B-JA0GaBTMPvH2LiW3A4yIaw9moTAkw2ENFx5Lhprttt-txK2xfIo1fLiRaiAEdIElTSjIZuMCRfguFuBD5HO1_qtMJOsQWk-3NhiHgMvBvFVmNZIuGzFGm6uPmdJdEF1cmdbu6Df0ygvj_N5SVc6g2KSxI2Py6M8ekkIccNwFOGp429WrS76IWkhGxy18TAHmetTQvmgoAmix4rwTPZ2iaHrYclKk4dlH9be13xYO0oCWjJfmbN1Cg88MDNyKR5aRqcAjc6lkj7gTXuMsulae2Gfm25o7Z-RktMHTx_FFLzeyilcw-U9KBVO3kWY9xMq97ciEuK5TDunjabO123d42OjmHeQRKNTpfQHoFWRRePLZiH7IcWmMVgfa53Egd_xca-7gpIWLK8stqGtFg86hZNMqimTfUC1iLTDI2euKPH0n5PNc4Yoomx2jasV3LkFceqgVJzF8M-l05gtnIYH0L1Ps-5VWIoyQwu4NgRoyxfLammvcwuJ_ewgZPOknCQogMdO8nvWD0my232Y8aOtl9H38yKdBizQV03V_DpKwqisb7-INw4qZvANr_l1cKxpquxS-SQG2GjLmJX4AK5jR-hGvXOaQNDO3YbJESX3I7y40T8lZPtMSSTPCRkuzsxbGIMBfgaOjUC_)
---
I have seen firsthand how powerful these moments can be. They remind me of the words of Jesus: "Let the little children come to Me and do not hinder them." (Matthew 19:14) Every child deserves safety, protection and **every child deserves to know they are loved.** **And sometimes God uses something as simple as a dog named Molly to help a hurting child take the first step toward healing.** What many people do not realize is that dogs like **Molly** require up to two years of specialized training. They are carefully prepared to remain calm in chaotic situations. They comfort children experiencing trauma and support officers carrying enormous emotional burdens.

They serve in places where hope can feel hard to find. This training, care, and support are only possible because compassionate people choose to stand with this mission.

When fear takes over, Molly brings comfort, trust, and the first steps toward healing. | | | | | | | | GOD'S CHILDREN ARE NOT FOR SALE | | | | Peter, A child who has been trafficked often learns a heartbreaking lesson: Don't trust anyone. Not adults. Not authority figures. Not even the people trying to help. That is one of the many reasons I am writing to you today. My name is Eduardo Verastegui. I am the producer of the film Sound of Freedom and founder of the Sound of Freedom Foundation. After learning firsthand about the horrors of child trafficking, I dedicated my life to helping protect vulnerable children and supporting efforts to stop this evil. Over the years, I have met brave men and women who dedicate their lives to rescuing children from trafficking and exploitation. They walk into places most of us could never imagine. They investigate crimes no human being should ever have to see. They sit with children whose innocence has been stolen. And they carry those memories with them. Day after day. Year after year. That burden is heavy. Sometimes heavier than words can describe. And that is why I want you to meet someone very special. Her name is Molly. Molly is a Labradoodle. But to the officers, investigators, and rescued children she serves, she is so much more than a dog. She is a source of comfort. A source of peace. A source of healing. When an officer has spent hours working a difficult trafficking case, when they've witnessed evil no person should ever have to witness and the weight of the day feels almost unbearable...Molly quietly walks over. She leans against them. And she stays. She does not ask questions. She does not need explanations. Her presence alone reminds them they are not carrying this burden by themselves. Sometimes that simple moment is enough to help someone breathe again. But Molly's work does not stop there. Some of the children rescued from trafficking are terrified, confused, and broken. Many have been manipulated for so long that they do not immediately trust the people trying to help them. Imagine that. Rescue has arrived. But trauma has taught them to fear everyone. Then Molly enters the room. No uniform. No questions. No pressure. Just gentleness and love. And somehow, walls begin to come down. Small hands reach out. Tears begin to flow. Fear begins to soften. And healing can begin. That healing does not happen by accident. It happens because one of our trusted anti-trafficking partners walks alongside survivors and the agencies that serve them. They provide trauma-informed support, resources, and advocacy for lives shattered by trafficking. Every day, they help children move from fear to freedom, from exploitation to safety, and from hopelessness to renewed hope. I have seen firsthand how powerful these moments can be. They remind me of the words of Jesus: "Let the little children come to Me and do not hinder them." (Matthew 19:14) Every child deserves safety, protection and every child deserves to know they are loved. And sometimes God uses something as simple as a dog named Molly to help a hurting child take the first step toward healing. What many people do not realize is that dogs like Molly require up to two years of specialized training. They are carefully prepared to remain calm in chaotic situations. They comfort children experiencing trauma and support officers carrying enormous emotional burdens. They serve in places where hope can feel hard to find. This training, care, and support are only possible because compassionate people choose to stand with this mission. Peter, every rescue operation involves people willing to walk into darkness so others can find freedom. But even heroes need support. And so do the children they serve.And sometimes healing begins with four paws, a gentle heart, and a quiet presence named Molly. Today, I am asking if you will become part of that healing. Because every child matters. Every rescue matters. And every act of compassion matters. Will you make your first gift today? Together, we can help protect God's children and bring light into some of the darkest places on earth. With gratitude and prayer, Eduardo Verastegui Sound of Freedom, Producer For the Sound of Freedom Foundation P.S. Molly cannot rescue a child by herself. But she helps wounded children begin to trust again. She helps exhausted officers keep going. And she reminds everyone she meets that compassion still exists. Your gift today helps provide that healing presence where it is needed most. 6671 Southwest Freeway, Suite 700, Houston TX 77074

| | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw
